## Review

**7 out of 10, Effective.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The deck has a clear spine: a recurring three-circle roadmap (slides 11, 12, 17, 26, 30) with progress dots on section slides, and each business repeats the same sequence of at-a-glance tile slide, market chart, strategy and financial summary, then key takeaways. Slides carry one conclusion in a navy banner (13, 16, 28, 95), and the big-number layout on slide 13 and the waterfall on slide 95 read quickly. Weaknesses are consequential: many mid-deck slides are dense with tiny text and thin icons (22, 37 to 42, 62 to 66), the at-a-glance mosaics (35, 49, 60, 71) mix photos and stat tiles in uneven sizes, and the waterfall charts lack data labels on the steps. The roadmap slides use faint grey-out states and small overlapping text in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and the 116-page length with near-identical roadmap and takeaways pages adds repetition. I only saw 72 of 116 pages, so the later commercial and financial sections are unjudged.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the repeated roadmap slide with progress dots, the navy takeaway banner on each content slide, and the consistent per-segment sequence that lets an investor compare Imaging, Ultrasound, PCS and PDx.

**Most useful repair:** Increase text size and thin out the dense pages on 22, 37 to 42 and 62 to 66, fix the cramped line spacing in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and put values on the waterfall steps on slides 45, 67 and 95.

**What would change the score:** Cut the at-a-glance mosaics to a cleaner stat row with one consistent image treatment and trim the repeated roadmap and takeaway pages to shorten the deck.

_Confidence medium. 72 of 116 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

The deck is the investor day presentation GE HealthCare gave on December 8, 2022, ahead of its spin-off from General Electric. It opens with an agenda and a disclaimer, then a catalyst slide and board and leadership introductions. The vision section frames the company's goal of creating a world where healthcare has no limits, followed by its market size, a four-segment leadership overview and a precision care strategy. Each business is then covered in turn: Imaging, Ultrasound, Patient Care Solutions and Pharmaceutical Diagnostics, with segment-specific markets, pipelines and financials. Commercial strategy and a financial strategy section follow, with a recurring revenue split and a medium-term margin bridge. The deck closes with a value creation summary, a closing slide and supplemental non-GAAP material. Slides worth studying include the medium-term financial targets that repeat as a bookend, the segment-by-segment structure with consistent market-size and growth callouts, and the Lean margin bridge. Many slides use a single headline claim with supporting figures in a clean grid.

## Questions about this deck

**How many pages does the GE HealthCare Investor Day presentation have?**

The deck has 116 pages. Slide 2 lists the agenda, which runs from opening remarks through segment reviews, financial strategy and closing remarks.

**What market size does the GE HealthCare Investor Day deck give for its business?**

Slide 13 states a total addressable market of $84 billion in 2021, estimated to reach about $100 billion by 2025. Slide 14 gives industry sizes for 2021 of $44B for Imaging, $12B for Ultrasound, $18B for Patient Care Solutions and $10B for Pharmaceutical Diagnostics.

**What are the medium-term financial targets in the GE HealthCare Investor Day deck?**

Slide 11 lists mid-single digit organic revenue growth and high-teens to 20% adjusted EBIT margin as medium-term targets, both marked as non-GAAP financial measures. The same targets repeat on slides 12, 17, 26 and 30.

**How is the GE HealthCare Investor Day presentation structured?**

Slide 2 shows the agenda in order: opening remarks by Larry Culp, vision and strategy by Peter Arduini, then Imaging, Ultrasound, Patient Care Solutions and Pharmaceutical Diagnostics, followed by commercial strategy, a break, financial strategy by Helmut Zodl and closing remarks by Peter Arduini.

**Layout**

Single slide with a title at top left, a GE HealthCare logo at top right, and a full-width purple band occupying the middle of the slide. Inside the band, ten portraits sit in two rows of five on a regular grid, each with a centred name and a centred title beneath it. The copyright line sits bottom right and the page number sits at the far bottom right margin; no visible footer rule.

**Visuals**

Ten circular portrait photographs, five in the top row and five in the bottom row, all rendered as blue-tinted monochrome duotone with a soft drop shadow beneath each circle. Top row, left to right: Larry Culp (man, short grey hair, dark suit, smiling, head and shoulders, white shirt); Peter Arduini (man, short hair, smiling, dark jacket over open-collar shirt); Dr. Rodney F. Hochman (man, grey hair, smiling, dark suit and striped tie, darker tone); Lloyd W. Howell, Jr. (man, short dark hair, smiling, dark suit, white shirt); Dr. Risa Lavizzo-Mourey (woman, short curly grey hair, smiling, dark top). Bottom row, left to right: Catherine Lesjak (woman, shoulder-length brown hair, smiling, dark jacket); Anne T. Madden (woman, long wavy blonde hair, neutral expression, black high-neck top); Dr. Tomislav Mihaljevic (man, short grey hair, smiling, dark suit, tie); William J. Stromberg (man, white hair, smiling, dark suit, white shirt); Phoebe L. Yang (woman, shoulder-length dark hair, smiling, white jacket). Each portrait is a head-and-shoulders crop inside a full circle, lit evenly from the front, with a pale blue (#CFE3F5) tint in the light areas and grey-blue shadows. The GE HealthCare logo is a purple monogram roundel with a purple wordmark 'GE HealthCare' to its right, in colour #640ACD on white. No photographs are boxed or cropped to a rectangle.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a full-width purple #640ACD band across the middle of the slide. White slide background with a single full-width purple (#640ACD) horizontal band across the middle from about 16.7% to 89.8% of slide height, with a soft grey shadow along its bottom edge. Title text is purple #640ACD in ArialMT regular, roughly 5.2% of slide height, sentence case. Names are cyan #59CBE8 in ArialMT regular capitals, about 2.2% of slide height. Titles are white #FFFFFF in ArialMT regular, about 2.04% of slide height, centred. Footer copyright and page number are black #000000 ArialMT regular about 1.6% of slide height. Portraits are circles with soft drop shadows; no corner radii, no gradients other than the band shadow. Overall sans-serif, flat, high-contrast layout.

### Slide 9

**Text**

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a left text column on white with the logo, a purple rule and the tagline vertically centred, and a right column of four stacked photographs flush to the right edge with equal widths and small vertical gaps. **Visuals**

Four photographs stacked in the right column, each a full-width rectangle with hard edges and no overlay or tint. Second photo: a doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope pushes a bed with a patient wearing an oxygen mask under a white blanket, while two nurses in blue scrubs walk alongside; white corridor walls and a glass railing on the right. Third photo: a man in a blue polo and a woman in blue scrubs smile at a wall-mounted ultrasound monitor showing grayscale images, with a cart and keypad below; dark brown wood background. Bottom photo: a smiling man in blue scrubs stands beside a CT gantry, with a patient lying on the bed inside the bore; dark blue tones with a lit corridor at right, cropped at the bottom edge by the slide. Also a purple horizontal rule under the logo, about 0.9% of slide height, rounded ends, colour #640ACD.

### Slide 11

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A four-pillar summary of the medium-term targets is repeated at the start, middle and end of the deck, so the audience keeps the same frame throughout.
- Review: The deck has a clear spine: a recurring three-circle roadmap (slides 11, 12, 17, 26, 30) with progress dots on section slides, and each business repeats the same sequence of at-a-glance tile slide, market chart, strategy and financial summary, then key takeaways.
- Review: The roadmap slides use faint grey-out states and small overlapping text in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and the 116-page length with near-identical roadmap and takeaways pages adds repetition.
- Suggested repair: Increase text size and thin out the dense pages on 22, 37 to 42 and 62 to 66, fix the cramped line spacing in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and put values on the waterfall steps on slides 45, 67 and 95.

**Layout**

Single-slide content area on the left about 70% wide with a full-height purple panel on the right about 28% wide whose left edge is a large convex curve. The title sits top-left at about 4% from the left edge and 7% from the top, left-aligned. Three equal circles sit in a horizontal row at mid-height, joined by short connectors. The panel holds the heading 'Driving Growth' and four icon-and-text rows, left-aligned. The footnote sits bottom-left, the copyright line bottom-centre-right, and the page number at bottom-right on the purple panel edge.

**Visuals**

Three filled circles in a left-to-right row, each with a thin concentric broken ring (arc segments) around it: circle 1 slate blue #56718C, circle 2 light cyan #59CBE8, circle 3 navy #002D5D. Each circle holds centred white text. Between circles are black dot-and-line connectors (black dots about 1 percent of width at each circle edge, with a short black horizontal line); after circle 3 a black line runs right to a solid black arrowhead pointing into the purple panel. Right panel holds four white line icons in a column: (1) bar chart with rising trend arrow, (2) pie chart with one slice pulled out, (3) banknote with dollar sign held in a hand, (4) dollar sign with connected nodes on both sides. No photographs. No charts or tables. Decorative light purple #640ACD arcs at 20 percent opacity sit behind the panel and along its left edge, plus a few short diagonal strokes at top right and bottom.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a purple #640ACD panel covering the right side.

**Layout**

Three equal circles sit in a horizontal row across the left two-thirds of the slide, joined by black dot-and-line connectors that end in an arrow pointing into a tinted right-hand panel covering the right 28% of the slide. The title is top-left at about 6.8% from the top with a left margin of about 4.2%; the right panel holds the 'Driving Growth' heading and four icon-plus-text rows. The footnote sits bottom-left at about 8% from the left, the copyright line sits bottom-centre-right, and the page number '12' sits at the bottom right near the edge.

**Visuals**

Three circles: the first is dark slate blue #56718C, the second and third are light blue-grey #BFCBD8, each with white text and thin concentric broken ring arcs in the same colours around its edge (ring arcs are estimated, not measured). Between circles and to the arrow there are four connector images: black filled dots joined by a short black horizontal line, the last ending in a black filled triangular arrowhead pointing right into the panel. Right panel: a large curved shape in #BFCBD8 with a concave left edge, overlaid by about 22 translucent #95A9BE arcs at 20% opacity forming faint curved bands on the left edge. Four white line icons in the panel, top to bottom: a rising bar chart with an upward arrow (bars and arrow in white outline); a pie chart with one wedge pulled out (white outline); a hand holding a phone or banknote with a dollar sign (white outline); a dollar sign connected to four circular nodes by lines (white outline, network style). No photographs; no charts with axes; no logos.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background; dark slate blue and light blue-grey circles; right panel in light blue-grey #BFCBD8 with translucent #95A9BE arcs. Title in purple #640ACD, Arial regular, size about 5.2% of slide height, sentence case. Circle text is white Arial regular about 3.3% of slide height, centred. Panel heading 'Driving Growth' white Arial regular about 5.2% of slide height. Panel body text white Arial regular about 2.6% of slide height with tight leading. Footer text black Arial regular about 1.5% of slide height. Connectors black, about 0.4% stroke. Circles flat with no shadow; arcs have no shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about x 4 and y 7, left-aligned, with a decorative three-circle pill at top right and its caption beneath. Four photo columns (about x 20 to 96) sit in the middle band, each with a round icon badge and purple bold label below; a light grey-blue row band holds Industry Size and the two data rows run beneath the labels, with a left label gutter of about 4 to 20 percent. A full-width navy band spans y 85.7 to 92.7 with a white centred headline, and the footer line, copyright and page number sit at the bottom around y 95.

**Visuals**

Four photographs in a row, each boxed with square corners and no overlay: (1) Imaging, about x 20.2 y 28.8 w 18.3 h 23.1: a white CT scanner gantry and patient table in a bright white room with cyan and magenta LED light strips along the wall and ceiling; cool lighting, dominant white, lavender-grey and magenta. (2) Ultrasound, about x 39.4 y 28.7 w 18.3 h 23.2: a female clinician in navy scrubs with short brown hair pointing at an ultrasound monitor showing a grey scan image, while a patient's leg is in the foreground; soft daylight through a window behind, dominant colours navy, beige and muted green. (3) Patient Care Solutions, about x 58.5 y 28.7 w 18.3 h 23.1: a surgical team in blue caps and masks in an operating room with a surgical light overhead, a monitor and keyboard cart in the foreground; blue-teal tones. (4) Pharmaceutical Diagnostics, about x 77.9 y 28.8 w 18.3 h 22.9: a blue-tinted surgical drape background with four overlaid medical scan images (green brain scan, grey brain scan, purple tissue square, teal heart scan) in a grid; dominant blue and purple.
Four circular icon badges, each about 4.9 by 8.8 percent, light grey (#E4E8EE) with soft shadow: imaging badge shows a CT gantry outline in black line art (x 22.0 y 52.7); ultrasound badge shows a wall-mounted device with a probe and cable in black line art (x 40.5 y 52.7); patient care badge shows a heartbeat line in a magnifying glass in black line art (x 58.0 y 52.7); pharmaceutical badge shows a vial or jar in black line art (x 77.4 y 52.7).
Decorative top-right element: a white rounded pill (x 81.2 y 3.8 w 18.8 h 9.4) with a soft grey shadow containing three circles; the first is a filled slate blue (#5B7592) ring-shaped circle, the other two are pale blue-grey (#B8C7D6) circles with thin concentric rings. A thin slate line runs from the first circle down to the caption.
A light grey-blue band (#DBE2E9 at 62 percent opacity, x 4.2 y 60.8 w 92.0 h 8.4) sits behind the Industry Size row.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. Plain white background with a clean corporate look. Titles and segment labels in vivid purple #640ACD; body figures in black #000000; row labels in dark navy #0C2340; the bottom banner is navy #002D5D with white text. Typeface is Arial (ArialMT regular; Arial-BoldMT bold for segment labels and banner), sans-serif. Slide title is about 5.2 percent of slide height; body and figures about 3.3 percent; labels about 3.0 percent; footer about 1.5 percent. Two-row, three-column grid of KPI cells divided by thin vertical rules and one horizontal rule across the middle, with the title top-left at about 4.4% from the left edge and the cell content left-aligned in each cell. **Layout**

Four equal-width boxed panels sit in a row across the middle of the slide, each joined to the next by a small chevron arrow, with the title top-left and a logo badge top-right. A centred-width line of channel text sits below the panels, a full-width navy bar holds the bold takeaway near the bottom, and the copyright line and page number sit in the footer at bottom right; margins are about 3% left and right.

**Visuals**

Four photographic panels, each containing several product images on white backgrounds, joined by three right-pointing chevron arrows. Panel 1 (Prevention/Screening, left-to-right): a handheld ultrasound probe beside a tablet displaying an ultrasound image with a blue overlay, a tall mammography unit with a white gantry and a grey base, and a white CT scanner with a circular bore. Panel 2 (Diagnosis): a white CT gantry with a circular bore and control panel, a small clear vial with a blue-and-white label, and a tall white ultrasound cart with a black monitor displaying a cardiac scan. Panel 3 (Treatment): a rectangular photo of a surgical operating room with surgeons in blue-green scrubs and masks around a patient, overlapping a circular photo of a white interventional X-ray C-arm over an operating table, the circle with a soft grey shadow. Panel 4 (Monitoring): a circular photo of a clinician in a white coat holding a tablet with a waveform display, beside a stack of white bedside patient monitors showing green, yellow and red waveforms and numeric readouts (60, 98, 60, 120). Logo badge top-right: a rounded white pill containing three circles, the first dark slate blue #5A7391 with concentric rings, the other two pale blue-grey #B8C7D9 with thin rings. Colours are predominantly white, grey and blue-white with small blue and purple accents.

**Layout**

Three horizontal circles run left to right across the middle of a white slide, joined by short black connectors with arrow to a right-hand grey panel. The title sits top-left, left-aligned at about 4% from the left edge and 7% from the top. A footer row sits at the bottom with a left footnote, a centred-right copyright line and a page number at the bottom right. The right panel occupies the right 28% of the slide, full height, with the heading and four icon-and-text rows left-aligned inside it.

**Visuals**

Diagram: three circles connected in a chain. Circle 1 (left) is light grey #BFCBD8 with white text 'Global Leader in Attractive, Growing Market'. Circle 2 (centre) is cyan #59CBE8 with white text 'Executing on Precision Care Strategy' and is the highlighted step. Circle 3 (right of centre) is light grey #BFCBD8 with white text 'Increased Focus and Agility'. Each circle has a thin outer ring of broken pale grey or cyan arc segments around it. Connectors: a short black line with a filled black dot at each end joins circle 1 to circle 2 and circle 2 to circle 3. A longer black line with a black dot at its start and a black filled arrowhead at its end runs from circle 3 out to the right, ending at the edge of the right panel. Right panel: a large grey #BFCBD8 shape with a convex curved left edge, overlaid by many translucent #95A9BE arc and bar shapes at 20% opacity, and two thin white curved strokes running down the left side of the panel. Four white line icons sit in the panel: a rising bar chart with an upward arrow, a pie chart with one slice pulled out, a hand holding a banknote marked with a dollar sign, and a dollar sign between connected nodes. Their labels are listed under elements.

**Design**

Background: White #FFFFFF solid fill, with a light grey-blue #BFCBD8 curved panel covering the right side. Plain white background with a light grey-blue curved panel on the right. Title in a regular-weight sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-style) in purple #640ACD, about 5.2% of slide height capitals-and-lowercase. Body text in circles is white regular Arial/Helvetica, about 3.3% of slide height, centred. Panel heading 'Driving Growth' is white regular Arial, about 5.2%. Panel bullet labels are white regular Arial at about 2.6%. Footer text is black Arial at about 1.5%. Circles are flat fills #BFCBD8 and cyan #59CBE8 with no shadow and no gradient. Connectors are black 2 px lines with black round dots. Corner radii: none on text; circles are full circles. Arcs and ring segments have thin strokes in #BFCBD8 or #59CBE8, and the decorative arcs in the panel are semi-transparent (20% opacity).

**Layout**

Two-zone slide. A dark left column (about 0 to 40% of the width) holds a left-aligned text block starting at about 5% from the left edge, vertically centred between about 24% and 73% of the height. The right zone (about 40 to 100%) is a full-bleed photo with a blue tint, carrying a centred title at the top and a three-part diagram: a vertical stack of four circles at left, a central Patient ring with a chevron pair, and a stack of three lilac circles at right. The footer copyright line sits at about 57% from the left at the bottom, with the page number at about 95% from the left on the same baseline.

**Visuals**

Full-bleed photograph of a clinician’s hands holding and touching a tablet. The tablet screen shows a glowing cyan network and body-outline graphic with small numeric readouts. The photo is cropped to the full slide and tinted blue (#59CBE8) on the right zone; the left zone is covered by a dark translucent panel. Composition: tablet in the upper-middle, fingers pointing at the screen, dark hands and sleeve at the lower-left. Lighting is soft and cool; dominant colours are slate blue and cyan with dark shadows.
Diagram, left to right: (1) Four light-cyan (#59CBE8) circles stacked vertically, labelled Images, Pathology, Genomics, and Vitals / Labs, with a rotated bold white label Multi-modal Data running up the left side of the stack. A white bracket (thin line, about 0.2% stroke) joins the stack’s right side to a white chevron pointing right. (2) A white chevron arrow feeds into a central ring: a thin white inner circle with a thin white outer arc, the bold white word Patient in the centre, and the curved bold white label Digital Platform & AI on the upper arc. A second white chevron points right from the ring toward the right stack. (3) A white bracket joins the right side of the lilac stack to the second chevron. Three lilac (#DFC7FC) circles labelled Precision Diagnostics, Precision Therapy, and Precision Monitoring, each with a thin white double arc around it and a small white dot with a short horizontal stub on its left side as a connector.
No logos or icons are visible in the render apart from the placed top-right image listed under elements.

**Design**

Background is a photo with a cyan (#59CBE8) tint on the right zone and a near-black (#0D0D0D, 70% opacity) panel on the left. Titles are white (#FFFFFF), body text is white (#FFFFFF), and the diagram accents are cyan #59CBE8 and lilac #DFC7FC with white line work. Typefaces: GE Inspira Sans (humanist sans-serif, regular and bold) for all slide text; Arial for the footer and page number. Title size about 4.4% of slide height for the top title and about 5.9% for Precision Care; body text about 5.2% of slide height; diagram labels about 3.0%; footer about 1.6%. Shapes are flat with no shadows, gradients, or rounded corners beyond the circles. Line work is thin (about 0.1 to 0.2% of slide height) white.

**Visuals**

Illustration: a circular platform made of a white disc with a soft grey shadow on its lower-right edge, surrounded by a broken double ring of grey (#A4B3BF) arc segments of varying thickness, some thick and some hairline. Inside the disc are three stacked horizontal pill-shaped labels (Enterprise, Department, Device) in front of a vertical purple arrow pointing upward on their left. The arrow runs from the Device level up to the Enterprise level. Gradient wedge: a trapezoid that widens from the circle to the box, fading from near-white (#F4F7FA) at the circle edge to light blue-grey (#D3DCE5) at the box edge, with the top and bottom edges sloping into the box corners. Box: a rectangle outline in light grey-blue (#A4B3BF), about 2 px stroke, white fill, containing the text 'Delivering Precision Care' and 'Driving productivity and recurring revenue'. A thin cyan vertical line drops from the centre circle to a horizontal cyan line that runs beneath the pill, with the caption below it. **Layout**

Title sits top-left in a left column, with the purple D3 wordmark lower-left. The concentric ring diagram occupies the centre and runs from the left margin toward the right, with three horizontal chevron bars extending right from the ring into a white right panel holding the 'Deliver Precision Care' icon and caption. A pill-shaped progress tracker sits top-right, and the copyright line and page number sit along the bottom edge.

**Visuals**

Illustration: a concentric ring diagram. Outer dark navy ring (#002D5D) carries curved labels 'Edison™ digital platform as orchestrator' (upper left), 'AI as enabler ...all devices, platform' (upper right) and 'Multivendor ecosystem' (lower left). Middle light blue ring (#5BC8E8) carries curved labels 'Oncology' (top), 'Cardiology' (right) and 'Neurology' (left) in navy. Inner pale grey-blue disc (#BFC9D6) with a purple dotted circular path (#640ACD) ending in a small purple arrowhead at lower centre. Inside the disc are six navy line icons: a patient monitor on a stand (upper left), a software dashboard window with a check badge (upper right), a bedside monitor with wireless signal (left), a CT or MRI gantry (right), a specimen or drug vial (lower left), a mobile C-arm X-ray unit (lower centre), and a magnifier over an ECG waveform (lower right). A small white circle sits at the centre of the disc. Three horizontal chevron bars extend right from the ring: 'Smart Devices' (pale grey #BFC9D6 bar, navy chevron), 'Disease States' (light blue #5BC8E8 bar, navy chevron), 'Digital Platform' (navy #002D5D bar, white chevron). Icon at right panel: black outline document with two check marks and a heart at its lower right corner. Pill-shaped progress tracker at top right: white rounded capsule with three circles, the middle one filled light blue (#5BC8E8) and connected by a thin light blue line to the caption 'Executing on Precision Care Strategy'. Small white circular icon at the centre of the ring.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white background. Title and wordmark in purple #640ACD, regular-weight sans-serif (Arial) for title, bold geometric sans (GE Inspira Sans Bold) for the D3 mark. Ring and bars in navy #002D5D and light blue #5BC8E8, with pale grey-blue #BFC9D6 for the inner disc and first bar. Title text about 5.2% of slide height, body labels about 3.3%, footer and caption about 1.5%. Shapes have soft drop shadows (the ring and right panel cast subtle grey shadows). Icons are black or navy line art.

### Slide 21

**Text**

New Product Introductions Driving Growth / Introduced ~40 New Products at RSNA 2022 / Executing on Precision / Care Strategy / Indicates AI integration / Revolution / Apex / SIGNA™ / (1.5 and 3T) / Omni Legend / (PET / CT) / Portrait / Mobile-a) / Voluson / Expert 22 / CT Motion / Injector / AIR™ / Recon / DL / OEC 3D / End-tidal / Control / Software-a) / Vscan Air / Vivid / Cardiology / Imaging / Ultrasound / Business Segments / Patient Care / Solutions (PCS) / Pharmaceutical / Diagnostics (PDX) / >35% Of Equipment Orders From NPIs In 2021-b) with continued strong growth in 2022 / (a - Portrait Mobile CE marked and 510K pending in US. End-tidal-Control CE marked and FDA approved. / (b - Defined as percentage of product orders received in 2021 in Imaging, Ultrasound and PCS segments for products / introduced in the last 12 months. / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 21

**Layout**

Title block top-left, left-aligned at about 4% margin, with the title at the top and subtitle beneath it. A 'Executing on Precision Care Strategy' tracker pill sits top-right. A grey band holds a two-row grid of 12 product cards (5 cards in row one, 6 in row two) spanning the width, with a legend strip below, a full-width navy banner, footnotes bottom-left, copyright bottom-centre-right and page number 21 bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Twelve product cards, each a white rounded-free rectangle with a soft shadow, holding a product photograph and a name. Row 1: Revolution Apex CT scanner, front view, grey-white, centred, on white background; SIGNA (1.5 and 3T) MRI gantry, white, angled three-quarter view; Omni Legend (PET / CT) scanner, photo with purple-pink lit room, bed extended; Portrait Mobile, grey patient-monitoring module with dark screen showing green numbers, attached cables and electrode pads; Voluson Expert 22 ultrasound cart with dark monitor showing a fetal image. Row 2: CT Motion Injector, blue-and-white stand with two syringes on a mobile base; AIR Recon DL 3D brain MRI slice, grey-white brain on dark blue frame; OEC 3D C-arm system with monitors, white; End-tidal Control Software, photo of clinician in scrubs with monitor in operating room; Vscan Air handheld ultrasound probe beside phone showing colour Doppler image; Vivid Cardiology ultrasound cart with dark screen. Icons: a circular imaging icon, a cart-and-probe ultrasound icon, a magnifier-with-waveform Patient Care icon, and a vial icon for Pharmaceutical Diagnostics. Grey filled stars mark AI-integrated products (SIGNA, Omni Legend, Voluson Expert 22, AIR Recon DL, OEC 3D, Vivid Cardiology). Legend strip shows Imaging icon, Ultrasound icon, Patient Care icon and Pharmaceutical icon. Logos: none.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey-blue band #DBE2E9 behind the cards.

**Visuals**

Central 3D donut-style cycle diagram made of five curved segments around a central elliptical photograph: top purple segment labelled EARLY DETECTION and EMERGENCY (overlapping labels, two lines), left grey-blue segment labelled MONITORING (rotated text), right lavender segment labelled DIAGNOSIS (rotated text), lower-left cyan segment labelled INTERVENTION (rotated text), and lower-right light-cyan segment labelled PLANNING. Each segment has a grey 3D thickness/shadow on its lower edge. Centre: an elliptical photograph of an elderly woman with glasses lying in a white bed and smiling, while a clinician in blue scrubs leans in and holds a stethoscope to her chest; soft natural lighting, cool blue and white tones, subject centred and cropped to an ellipse with a white ring. Around the diagram a thick blue (#0A6EBD) elliptical arc links eight white circular icon badges, each with a navy-outlined ring: AI-powered CDS Suite (imaging icon with grey star), MAC 2000 (patient care icon, magnifier with ECG line), CARESCAPE™ (patient care icon), MyoSPECT Myoview (imaging icon with grey star), RPM Edison™ –a) (ultrasound icon with grey star), Vivid™ (ultrasound icon with grey star), Allia™ IGS (imaging icon with grey star), Revolution™ Apex (imaging icon with grey star). Legend bottom-left: imaging icon with label Imaging, ultrasound icon with label Ultrasound, magnifier patient care icon with label Patient Care Solutions (PCS), grey star with label Indicates AI integration, pharmaceutical icon (jar/box) with label Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDX). **Layout**

Two-zone layout on a white slide. The title sits top-left in a left column (about x 4% to 29%, y 7% to 37%), with a navy call-out bar anchored at the left edge (x 0% to 31%, y 68% to 84%). The hub-and-spoke diagram occupies the centre and right, roughly x 22% to 89%, y 0% to 100%. A rounded header pill with three circular nodes sits top-right (x 80% to 99%, y 3% to 14%) with a caption beneath it. The footer copyright line is right of centre at y 95% and the page number is at x 95%, y 95%. Margins are about 4% left and 5% top.

**Visuals**

Hub-and-spoke diagram on a faint grey network mesh. A large central cyan-ringed circle at about x 49% to 61%, y 40% to 62% reads 'Edison™ Digital Health Platform'. Six outer circular nodes sit around it in a ring, each with a thin cyan (#59CBE8) double ring and a black line icon above its label: top-left 'GEHC Imaging Fabric' with a monitor-and-user icon; top-right 'AI/ML Engine' with a brain icon; middle-left 'Third-Party Vendor & Data Integration' with a rising-line-chart-over-table icon; middle-right 'Development Platform' with a browser-window-and-code icon (small image at x 66.7%, y 44.5%, 3.6% by 6.5%); bottom-left 'Connected Care Pathways' with a stethoscope icon; bottom-right 'Leading Devices' with a CT-scanner icon, drawn in navy strokes. Thin grey-blue connector lines link the centre to each node and neighbouring nodes. Background image is a 1536 by 1536 pixel grey network sphere of nodes (grey dots) and light grey lines, spanning x 22.5% to 89.4%, full height, behind the hub. Header: a white rounded pill with a soft drop shadow containing three circles, light grey (#B9C2CE-like) on left, bright cyan (#59CBE8) filled middle with a cyan ring, and light grey on right; a cyan vertical line drops from the middle circle to a horizontal cyan rule under the pill. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in ArialMT regular, violet #640ACD, sans-serif, about 5.2% of slide height per line, line spacing about 6.2% of height. Navy call-out bar #002C5D with white ArialMT text about 3.0% of height. Node labels in black ArialMT about 2.2% of height, centred, with the centre label in bold Arial. Caption and footer text black ArialMT about 1.5% of height. Accent colour cyan #59CBE8. Line and shape styles: nodes are white-filled circles with thin cyan outlines and partial broken cyan arcs; connectors are thin light grey lines (#D5DAE0). The navy bar has a soft shadow at its right and bottom edges. The header pill has a rounded radius of about half its height and a faint grey shadow. No gradients.

24

**Layout**

Two-column content slide on a white field: a left column of two stacked purple stat boxes, a centre table of six rows labelled with CAGR values, and a right column with a bracket and bold purple statement. The title sits top-left at about 6.8% from the top and 4.2% from the left edge, with a small rounded pill logo top-right; a full-width navy band sits at about 81.6% to 88.6% of the height, with footnotes bottom-left and copyright and slide number on the bottom line, slide number at far right.

**Visuals**

Two solid purple rectangles on the left (each with a soft drop shadow) carrying white bold text: '$1B+ 2022E R&D' and '35%+ NPI vitality-a)'. A six-row table in the centre with alternating light grey-blue rows (#DBE2E9) for Premium CT, Handheld Ultrasound and MR Platforming, and white rows for Cardio, Oncology and AI Solutions; the column header 'Est. CAGR ‘22–‘25' sits right-aligned above the values column. Rows and values: Premium CT / PCCT ~10%-b); Cardio / 3-D Image-guided Therapies ~15%; Handheld Ultrasound ~20%; Oncology MI / Theranostics 20%+; MR Platforming ~5-7%; AI Solutions and Edison™ Platform 25%+-c). A thin black bracket line runs from the top of the table to the bottom of the table on its right side, with a small solid black chevron arrow pointing right at its midpoint toward the statement. Top-right: a white rounded pill-shaped logo panel with three circles (two grey, one cyan #5BC8E8 highlighted in the centre with a short cyan connector line down to a cyan rule) and the caption 'Executing on Precision Care Strategy'. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Plain white background with a flat, no-gradient look. Title text in purple #640ACD, regular-weight sans-serif (Arial-like), about 5.2% of slide height (cap height about 3.6%). Subheading 'Prioritizing Fastest-Growing Areas' in purple #640ACD, regular sans-serif, about 3.3%. Table row labels in black #000000 regular sans-serif about 3.0%; values about 3.3%. Purple stat boxes #640ACD with white bold sans-serif text about 3.7%. Right statement in bold purple #640ACD sans-serif about 4.4%. Navy band #002D5D with white bold sans-serif text about 3.3%. Footnotes and copyright in black regular sans-serif about 1.5%. Shapes have sharp corners, no rounded corners except the top-right pill logo panel, with a soft grey drop shadow on the purple boxes and pill panel.

**Layout**

Three-column grid of colour-tinted panels (light cyan, lavender, grey) sits between a title at the top left and a full-width navy banner near the bottom, with a row-label column at the far left and a right-hand text callout. Title is left-aligned at the top, starting about 4.2% from the left edge; the copyright line sits bottom right and the page number at the bottom right margin (about 94.8% x). A pill-shaped tracker with three circles sits top right, with a caption beneath it.

**Visuals**

Three-step chevron flow: three tinted column panels (cyan #DEF5FA, lavender #DFC7FC, grey #D2D9DF) each holding two white logo/label cards, linked left to right by three dark navy (#0C2340) solid chevron arrows placed between the panels at mid-height. Each white card holds a company logo at its top and a black label beneath. Top-row cards: Prismatic Sensors logo (black wordmark 'Prismatic' with a green square-pixel mark above 'sensors', greyscale/green) labelled 'Photon-Counting Tech'; bk medical logo (green 'bk' with a green sound-wave icon and 'medical' in green, light green accent) labelled 'Surgical Visualization'; ZIONEXA logo (navy stylised 'Z' with 'IONEXA' in navy and a red 'E' accent, with small red text 'CDx Imaging for Oncology') labelled 'Oncology and Neurology'. Bottom-row cards: RaySearch Laboratories logo (dark blue text with grey 'Laboratories' and a grey radiating star-like line graphic) labelled 'Radiation Oncology'; SOPHiA GENETICS logo (dark navy dot-cluster icon with navy text 'SOPHiA GENETICS' and trademark mark) labelled 'Precision Oncology'; AliveCor logo (teal-green 'AliveCor' wordmark with registered mark) above Pursuemore-style Pulsenmore logo (dark red 'Pulsenmore' with a red-grey sound-bar icon) labelled 'Alternative Care Settings'. Row labels 'ACQUISITIONS' (top) and 'COLLABORATIONS' (bottom) run vertically, bold navy, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. Column captions sit between rows: 'Goal to make treatment faster and more precise' in teal, 'Expanding into adjacencies' in purple, 'Capitalizing on emerging trends' in dark grey. A top-right pill-shaped tracker has three circles: left grey, centre bright cyan (#5BC8E8) filled and highlighted with a cyan connector line down to caption 'Executing on Precision Care Strategy', and right grey; the circles have thin concentric grey outlines.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in purple (#640ACD) regular sans-serif (Arial-like), about 5.2% of slide height, with cap height roughly 3.6%. Body captions in teal (#14748D), purple (#640ACD) and dark grey (#262626), regular Arial-like sans-serif about 3.0% of slide height. Row labels bold Arial-like sans-serif in navy (#0C2340) about 2.8%. Banner text white bold Arial-like sans-serif about 3.3%. Card labels black regular about 2.6%. Column panels are flat tinted rectangles with no border; white cards have a thin light grey border and soft drop shadow. Chevrons are solid navy. Right-side callout in purple regular sans-serif about 4.4%, centred. Top-right tracker is a white rounded pill with a soft shadow.

**Layout**

Single-slide layout on a 16:9 canvas. The title sits top-left, left-aligned at about 4.2% from the left edge and about 6.8% from the top. Three equal circles sit in one horizontal row across the left two-thirds, vertically centred near 50% of the height, joined by short connector lines with dot ends. A tall rounded-left grey panel fills the right edge (about 71.7% to 100% width) and holds the heading 'Driving Growth' and four icon-and-text rows stacked vertically, left-aligned at about 84.8%. Footnote at bottom left, copyright line bottom centre-right, page number bottom right.

**Visuals**

Three circular nodes in a row, each with a thin concentric broken-arc ring around it (light grey-blue arcs, rounded line ends, approximately 1 pt weight). Circle 1 and circle 2 are light grey-blue #BFCBD8 with white text; circle 3 is dark navy #002D5D with white text, highlighting the final stage. Between circles, black dot-and-line connectors: a dot, a short black horizontal line, then a dot, at the join between circles 1 and 2 and between circles 2 and 3. After circle 3 a black line with a dot at its start ends in a solid black arrowhead pointing right into the grey panel. Right panel: a large light grey-blue #BFCBD8 shape with a curved left edge, overlaid by a set of about 23 translucent #95A9BE shapes at 20% opacity forming soft curved arc bands and stripes behind and across the panel edge, plus a faint decorative arc graphic in the top-right corner. Four white line icons in the right panel, all outlined in white at about 2 pt stroke: (1) a rising bar chart with an upward arrow, aligned with 'Mid-single digit Organic Revenue Growth*'; (2) a pie chart with one wedge pulled out, aligned with 'High-teens to 20% Adj. EBIT margin*'; (3) a hand holding a banknote marked with a dollar sign, aligned with 'Strong Free Cash Flow* Generation'; (4) a dollar sign connected to four circular nodes by lines, aligned with 'Disciplined Capital Allocation'. No photographs; no logos apart from the text copyright line.

**Visuals**

Staircase illustration (about 42.8% to 96.3% across, 21.6% to 100% down): five stacked isometric steps rising from lower-right to upper-left, each a parallelogram-topped block with a darker front edge. Step colours from top to bottom: navy, violet, cyan-blue, teal, light cyan, then a grey base step. Each step carries a white-grey (#F2F2F2) teardrop pin with a black line icon, and a thin grey (#BFBFBF) horizontal leader line runs from each label to its step. Icons: (1) open hands cupping a heart; (2) head in profile with a gear and a lightbulb; (3) lightning bolt; (4) hand palm-up holding a speech bubble with a medical cross; (5) three figures with arms raised around a circle. Trophy icon at top-left of the subtitle: a navy (#002C5D) outline trophy with a star on the cup. Pill-shaped progress indicator top-right: white rounded pill with soft shadow containing three circles, the first two pale grey-blue (#C5CED9) and the third navy (#002C5D) with concentric ring detail, with a navy vertical connector and horizontal line leading to the caption 'Increased Focus and Agility'. Background wedge is a soft grey gradient image.

### Slide 28

**Text**

Optimizing our Operating Model as a
Standalone Company
Increased Focus
and Agility
Four Focused & Integrated Segments:
Imaging
Ultrasound
Patient Care
Solutions (PCS)
Pharmaceutical
Diagnostics (PDx)
Enterprise Account Management, Service Delivery
Global Digital Platform
Simplified, Customer-centric Structure Increases Our Speed & Agility
© 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved.
28

**Layout**

Two-line title sits top-left at about 4% margin, with a pill-shaped header graphic and caption at top right. A bold subtitle sits below the title, then a full-width light grey band holds four equal columns, each with a photo above an icon and label, separated by thin vertical rules. Two full-width grey bars with navy chevrons follow, then a full-bleed navy banner, then the copyright line bottom right and the page number at far right.

**Visuals**

Four photographs, one per column, each boxed (rectangular, no rounded corners, no overlay). (1) Imaging: a modern CT scanner gantry with a patient table in a clean room with cyan and magenta LED strip lighting along the ceiling and wall; cool lavender-grey floor; wide framing, full image visible. (2) Ultrasound: a woman in navy scrubs holding an ultrasound probe to a patient's knee covered by a grey cloth, while pointing at an ultrasound monitor on a cart; window with blurred autumn trees behind; dominant navy, beige and soft green. (3) Patient Care: an operating room with a surgeon in a blue cap and mask beside a monitor cart, another staff member in blue gown at left, overhead surgical light at top; green-tiled walls; dominant teal, navy and blue. (4) Pharmaceutical Diagnostics: blue-tinted surgical drapes as background with four framed scan images overlaid: a green brain scan at upper left, a colour CT slice at upper right, a purple angiogram square at lower centre and a glowing teal heart scan at lower right; blue overlay tint. Four circular icons (light grey circles with soft drop shadow, dark line icons): an outline of a CT gantry with a person, an ultrasound cart with probe, a magnifier over a heartbeat waveform, and a pill bottle outline. Two thin vertical dark grey rules divide the columns at about x 27.4%, 50.2% and 73.2%, from y 25.2% to 58.9%. Header graphic: three circles, the first two pale grey-blue (#C5CFDC) with thin concentric rings, the third solid navy #002D5D with rings, joined by a navy vertical line to a horizontal navy line beneath it. Four solid navy chevrons (#002D5D): two pointing left at about x 15.9 to 18.0% and two pointing right at about x 84.3 to 86.4%, one pair in each grey bar.

### Slide 29

**Text**

Committed to Enhancing Our ESG Strategy / Five Focus Areas / Access to healthcare / Climate impact & resilience / Circular economy & environmental design / Inclusion & diversity / Cybersecurity & patient data / Environment and Climate / Goal to reduce emissions by 50% by 2030-a) / Net zero by 2050 / Social Capital / 31% of leadership female-b) / 27% ethnically diverse-c) / New Chief DE&I Officer / Governance and Leadership / Enterprise Stewardship Program / Completed materiality assessment / Prioritizing ESG to Support Long-Term Value Creation / (a - Refers to Scope 1 and 2 absolute emissions versus a 2019 baseline. / (b - Leadership encompasses the top 1.5% of all active employees. / (c - Data representative of GE’s U.S. workforce as of December 31, 2021, extracted in January 2022. / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 29 / Increased Focus and Agility

**Layout**

Three-zone layout on a 16:9 slide. A purple title sits top-left at about 4% left margin and 7% from the top, with a small navigation pill with a caption at top-right. Below, a left column (about 4% to 33% of width) holds a boxed list of five numbered focus areas. A narrow chevron/bracket connector sits at about 35% to 38% of width. The right side is a three-row table-like grid (about 41% to 96% width), each row with a grey label cell on the left and a white bullet cell on the right, spanning from 21.5% to 79% of height. A full-width navy band spans 81.6% to 88.6% of height with centred white bold text. Footnotes sit bottom-left at 91.6% to 96.6% of height, with copyright text centred at about 57% and the page number at bottom-right at 95% of height.

**Visuals**

1) Navigation pill (top-right): a white rounded pill with soft shadow holding three circles. The first two are light grey-blue circles with thin concentric rings, the third is a solid navy #002D5D circle with concentric rings, and a thin navy leader line runs down from it to the caption Increased Focus and Agility. 2) Left panel: a white rectangle with a 3 pt light cyan #5BC8E8 border and a soft drop shadow, holding five numbered cyan circles (1 to 5) with white bold numerals. 3) Connector: a navy #002D5D thin bracket line (about 0.15% stroke) running from the top of the left panel to the bottom of the grid, with a solid black chevron arrow pointing right at about 36% to 38% of width and 48% to 53% of height. 4) Icons in the grey label cells, drawn in navy #002D5D line art: a globe with meridians and latitude lines (Environment and Climate row, about 42.5% x, 25.8% y, 4.6% w, 6.5% h); a classical building with pediment and columns (Social Capital row, about 42.7% x, 43.5% y, 3.5% w, 5.5% h); a group of three people above a rounded oval (Governance and Leadership row, about 42.3% x, 61.7% y, 4.5% w, 5.0% h). 5) Two placed raster images: one 396 by 444 px at 3.6% x, 21.2% y, 29.7% w, 59.1% h, which appears to be a soft shadow layer behind the left panel, and one 339 by 335 px at 7.6% x, 28.6% y, 25.4% w, 44.5% h, which shows no discernible content at this scale.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate style. White background. Title in purple #640ACD, regular weight sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica style), about 5.2% of slide height for the title cap-height block. Body text black #000000, regular sans-serif (Arial), about 2.2% of slide height. Section labels and headings in bold black #000000 sans-serif (Arial Bold), about 3.0% of slide height. Bullet glyphs dark slate #1D252C. Accents: light cyan #5BC8E8 for numbered circles and the left panel border; navy #002D5D for the banner, the nav pill's active circle and connector lines; grey-blue #DBE2E9 for the label cells; white #FFFFFF for bullet cells. Bullet cells are outlined with thin grey-blue #8A9BAA rules (about 0.1% of height). Left panel has a soft drop shadow. Navy banner is flat with no gradient. Nav pill has a soft grey shadow. No rounded corners on the grid; the list circles are perfect circles.

Four-column band of tiles across the lower middle of the slide under two side-by-side bullet columns, with a full-width navy banner beneath the tiles and a copyright line and page number in the footer. The title sits top-left on one line, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right; left margin about 5% of slide width, and the two header columns are centred over their halves.

**Visuals**

Four equal-width rectangular tiles, each with a white line icon beside its name: Imaging (outline of an MRI-style gantry with a patient table), Ultrasound (ultrasound cart with a probe and wave arcs), PCS (magnifying glass over a heartbeat/waveform line), PDx (a vial or bottle outline). Tile fills from left to right: #2B3846, #56718C, #95A9BE, #AFBAC9. Each tile lists three white bullets and a bold white label at the bottom: Margin Priority, Revenue Priority, Margin Priority, Revenue Priority. The GE HealthCare logo is a purple monogram circle with the wordmark 'GE HealthCare' in purple #640ACD. None of the icons or logos are photographs.

### Slide 36

**Text**

Attractive End Market Trends Driving Growth / GE HealthCare / Estimated End Markets / New Procedures and Growing Healthcare Demand Driving Imaging Markets / $44B end markets: 4-6% CAGR-a) / $53B-b) / $44B / 2021A / 2025E / Increasing penetration of imaging technologies in diagnosis / Growth in broad-based population screening programs / Tech / AI expanding indications for high-end diagnostic exams / New therapeutic procedures require precision imaging guidance / (a - Estimated from 2022-2025 / (b - Represents the midpoint of the range / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 36

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white slide: a narrow light-grey left panel (about 35% of the width) holds the 'Estimated End Markets' bar chart and footnotes, and a wider right column (from about 37% to 96% of the width) holds a heading with a rule and a white card with four icon-and-text rows. The title sits top-left at about 6.8% from the top with the GE HealthCare logo top-right; the copyright line sits bottom-right with the page number at the far right bottom margin, and footnotes are bottom-left.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled 'Estimated End Markets' with no visible axis line other than a thin horizontal baseline beneath the bars. Categories: 2021A and 2025E. Series: one series of two bars. 2021A bar labelled '$44B' (cyan #59CBE8). 2025E bar labelled '$53B' with superscript '-b)' (navy #002A5C). No y-axis, no gridlines, no legend. A purple arrow (#640ACD, about 2px line with open arrowhead) rises from the top of the 2021A bar to the top of the 2025E bar, indicating growth. The chart is labelled by a boxed callout above it reading '$44B end markets: 4-6% CAGR' with superscript '-a)'. Right side: four purple outline icons in circles, each with a dashed-arc ring: (1) a smartphone with a speech bubble containing a plus sign; (2) a heart containing an ECG pulse line; (3) a clipboard with a medical cross; (4) a stethoscope. Each icon is matched to one text row. The icons are in #640ACD purple outlines on white.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background (#FFFFFF). Slide titles and section headings in purple #640ACD, bold section headings in Arial Bold. Body and labels in black #000000. Accent colours: cyan #59CBE8 and navy #002A5C in the chart; purple #640ACD in headings, arrow, icons and logo. Typeface: Arial (Helvetica-like sans-serif), regular weight for title and body, bold for the two section headings. Title size about 5.2% of slide height, body row text about 3.0%, chart labels about 2.6%, footnotes and copyright about 1.5%. **Layout**

Two-column composition on a white slide: a left-hand data table occupies roughly the left 41% (x 2.3% to 41.1%, y 23.2% to 78.5%) and a circular diagram occupies the right side (x about 42% to 98%, y about 23% to 82%). The title sits top-left at x 2.8%, y 6.3%, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right (x 80%, y 4.2%). Footnotes are bottom-left at x 3.3%, copyright bottom-centre-right at x 57.4% and the page number bottom-right at x 94.8%, y 95%. Left margin about 2.3% of slide width, all text left-aligned except centred table values and centred diagram labels.

**Visuals**

Table: 3 columns and 5 rows. Column 1 (x 2.3% to 22.4%) holds row labels; column 2 (x 22.4% to 32.2%) is headed 'Industry' with superscript 'a)' and holds values; column 3 (x 32.2% to 41.1%) is headed 'Growth' with superscript 'b)'. Row 1 header (y 23.2%, h 8.0%) is white with no fill. Rows: MI & CT | ~$8B | ~3-5%; MR | ~$6B | ~5-7%; X-Ray & Women’s Health | ~$4B | ~1-3%; Image-Guided Therapies | ~$4B | ~4-6%. Row fills alternate #F1F4F7 and #F8FAFB, each row 11.8% high (y 31.2%, 43.0%, 54.8%, 66.7%). No gridlines. Diagram: a dark navy (#002A5C) thick circular outline ring of about 2.5% stroke with four curved arrowheads placed at roughly 12 o'clock-left, 2 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 8 o'clock positions, running clockwise around the ring. Around the ring are six category labels in bold navy caps: FINANCIAL SERVICES (upper left), CARE PATHWAYS (upper right), DIGITAL SOLUTIONS (right), DATA INTEGRATION (lower right), SERVICE & LIFECYCLE (lower left), EDUCATION & TRAINING (left). Inside the ring is a dotted light-grey circular track and a solid slate-blue (#56718C) central disc (x 62.6%, y 37.0%, w 17.5%, h 31.7%) with thin dotted spoke lines radiating from the centre, and the white text BETTER HEALTH FOR ALL on the disc. Below-left of the disc a horizontal bar is split into ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS (navy #002A5C box) and IMAGING SOLUTIONS (slate #56718C box). Nine line-art icons in navy-outlined grey-blue line drawings sit on the track: Bone & Metabolic Health (table-top X-ray/bone densitometer-type scanner), X-Ray (C-arm on a stand), CT (gantry scanner seen front-on), Ultrasound (portable ultrasound cart with screen), Image-Guided Systems (C-arm angiography system with monitor), Mammography (compression unit), Surgical Imaging (mobile C-arm on wheeled cart), MRI (gantry scanner seen front-on), Molecular Imaging (scanner bed seen from side). Icons are flat, white-filled, outlined in navy, no shadows. Lighting and photographic qualities do not apply.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the full slide. Plain white background with no gradients or textures. Title is purple (#640ACD) regular-weight geometric sans (Arial/Helvetica-like), about 4.9% of slide height. Table row labels are bold purple #640ACD, about 2.8% of slide height; table values are regular black #000000, about 3.0%; table header Industry/Growth is bold purple #640ACD, about 3.0%. Diagram labels are bold navy #002A5C at about 2.6% for category labels and regular navy #002A5C at about 1.8% for icon captions. Central disc text is bold white about 3.0%. Footnotes and copyright are regular black about 1.5%. Accents: purple #640ACD, navy #002A5C, slate #56718C. Table fills #F1F4F7 and #F8FAFB, no borders. Ring is a single navy stroke with no shadow. No corner radii except square label boxes.

38

**Layout**

Two equal columns side by side below a title at top left, with the GE HealthCare logo at top right. Each column has a coloured header bar above a white panel with a soft shadow; the left panel holds three stacked rows (photo left, text right) separated by dashed rules, and the right panel holds three similar rows. Margins are about 4 percent on the left and 4 percent on the right. Footnotes sit bottom left, the copyright line bottom centre-right, and the page number 38 bottom right.

**Visuals**

Six photographs and illustrations plus one logo. (1) Left row 1: photograph of a patient lying supine on a CT table, head toward the camera, inside the round gantry aperture, with red laser alignment lines crossing the scene; dominant colours red, dark grey and black; full-frame rectangular crop, not boxed, no overlay. (2) Left row 2: 3D rendered anatomical heart with reddish-pink myocardium and pale grey-white great vessels at the top and coronary arteries in red and white, on white background, cut out with no box. (3) Left row 3: 3D rendered cube of cyan and teal fibrous volume with a bright white band and a grey brain scan slice in a dark corner, set inside a thin light grey-blue outline box. (4) Right row 1: photograph of three white and grey CT scanners in a row on a white background, shown from the front, cut out with no box. (5) Right row 2: purple interlocking double-loop icon, two linked loops in a purple tone about #7F5FB8, on white. (6) Right row 3: photograph of the dark interior of a CT gantry with a bright white glowing aperture in the centre, dark surround, small indicator lights at the corners, and a faint blue reflection on the floor; dominant colours black, white and blue; boxed rectangle, no overlay. (7) Logo top right: GE HealthCare logo, a purple circular monogram with the letters GE in white-outlined script, followed by the wordmark GE HealthCare in purple. Dashed rules: two purple dashed horizontal lines in the left panel and two light grey dashed horizontal lines in the right panel.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with purple and cyan accents. Title and left header are purple #640ACD, right header is light cyan #59CBE8, body text is black #000000, and right-column subheadings are cyan #59CBE8. The typeface is Arial (ArialMT) regular throughout, with title about 5.2 percent of slide height, column headers about 3.3 percent, subheadings about 2.6 percent and body about 2.2 percent. Panels are flat white with a faint grey drop shadow and square corners; header bars are flat solid fills with square corners. Dashed rules are thin. No gradients.

**Layout**

Two equal-width white cards side by side below a single title at top left, with the GE HealthCare logo at top right; each card has a coloured header bar spanning its full width. **Visuals**

Left card: three small greyscale and colour photographs stacked vertically at the left of each row. Row 1 is a grayscale radiograph of a hip showing two parallel metal pins or screws across the femoral head on a near-black background, with a tiny illegible caption strip along the bottom edge, boxed with square corners. Row 2 is a grayscale CT-style scan of a lung and thorax showing bright white rib arcs and branching vessels against dark grey, with small white marker shapes at the edges, boxed with square corners. Row 3 is a colour photograph of a clinician in blue scrubs, blue surgical cap and mask pointing at a wall monitor displaying a spine scan, in a bright operating room with pale blue drapes and a grey C-arm arc behind, boxed with square corners. Right card: a light cyan label box reading OEC 3D & 3D Volume Viewer, and beside it a colour photograph of a white and light grey mobile C-arm X-ray system with a curved C-arm arc, a monitor showing spine images on a cart, a second monitor cart at right and a small monitor on a stand, all on a white background with a GE logo on the units; the image is not cropped and has no overlay. Dashed separators: purple dashed horizontal lines in the left card and cyan dashed horizontal lines in the right card.

Footer and page number are black regular sans-serif at about 1.6%.

**Layout**

Two equal-width white panels sit side by side below the title, each with a coloured header bar across its top: purple on the left and light cyan on the right. The title is left-aligned at the top left, with the GE HealthCare logo at the top right. The left panel holds a PET image on the left and three stacked statistics on the right, with a precision-care line and bullet at the bottom. The right panel holds a product strip at top, then three stacked Discovery, Diagnosis and Treatment rows with icons and down arrows. The footnotes sit bottom left, the copyright line bottom centre-right, and the page number bottom right. Margins are about 4 percent on each side.

**Visuals**

Left: a coronal PET/CT image of a standing figure with arms raised, shown in a 314 by 650 pixel portrait frame, dark grey-black background, grey body silhouette with blue and orange-red hot spots in the liver, intestines and head. Not cropped; boxed with a sharp edge. Right top: a product strip image 1469 by 258 pixels showing five instrument photographs in a row over a cyan chevron band: the TracerCenter cyclotron-style unit with open door, the FASTlab 2 benchtop synthesis module, the Omni Platform patient table with a scanner, the StarGuide SPECT/CT gantry, and the Q.Thera AI item, which is a small stacked pair of body scan thumbnails in grey and colour, with labels below each. Right middle: three icons. Discovery icon: a magnifying glass over vials and a molecular node graphic, in blue, green and grey. Diagnosis icon: a PET/CT scanner gantry and a server rack in grey and blue. Treatment icon: a person silhouette in blue beside a monitor showing a graph and vials. Between the icons are three lavender-purple downward block arrows, about #B98BF2. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background plain white #FFFFFF. Title in Arial regular, purple #640ACD, about 5.2 percent of slide height, sentence case. Panel headers in Arial regular white #FFFFFF about 3.3 percent. Body statements in Arial regular purple #640ACD about 2.6 percent. Right panel labels in Arial regular cyan #59CBE8 with the descriptive text in Arial regular black #000000 about 2.6 percent. Footnotes and copyright in Arial regular about 1.5 percent, black with a purple hyperlink. Panels are white cards with a faint grey drop shadow and square corners. Header bars are flat with square corners. Dashed purple divider lines, about 0.1 percent stroke, separate the left statistics. Accent colours are purple #640ACD and cyan #59CBE8, with lavender arrows.

**Layout**

Single-slide landscape layout with the title top-left at about 4% margin and the GE HealthCare logo top-right. Below the title, a row of seven chevrons spans the width as a process flow, with a patient icon at the left; three horizontal bands (Devices, Digital/Data, Roadmap) stack beneath, separated by thin rules, with category labels in a left column and content in columns to the right. A navy banner sits at the bottom, with the copyright line and page number in the footer below it.

**Visuals**

Seven chevron-shaped process arrows in a horizontal row: the first (Patient Journey) is a pale grey-blue #DBE2E9 chevron with bold navy text, and the other six are slate #56718C chevrons with white text. A small purple line icon of a person with a heart symbol sits left of the chevrons. A purple line icon of a laptop, tablet and phone (devices) sits left of the Devices label. A purple line icon of a binary-code document (rows of 0111, 1011, 0010) sits left of Digital/Data. A GE HealthCare purple circular monogram with the wordmark GE HealthCare sits top-right. In the Digital/Data band three pale grey #DBE2E9 rectangles at 46% opacity hold text: a wide top bar, a shorter middle bar with AW PROVIEW and a bar to its right with Edison Datalogue, and a bottom bar with Centricity Universal Viewer. Two thin dark grey horizontal rules separate the bands at about 50% and 71% of slide height. The Roadmap band has a pale grey background.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a pale grey-blue #DBE2E9 band at 25% opacity behind the Roadmap section and a navy #002D5D banner at the bottom. White background with a pale grey roadmap band (#DBE2E9 at 25% opacity). Titles and section labels are purple #640ACD in ArialMT regular, title about 5.2% of slide height, section labels about 3.3%. Body text is black #000000 in ArialMT regular at about 2.2% of slide height. Chevron labels are white on #56718C; the Patient Journey label is bold navy #002A5C. The banner text is white bold ArialMT at about 3.3%. Accent colours are purple #640ACD and navy #002D5D. Chevrons are flat with no shadows or gradients; the dividing rules are thin dark grey lines.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white slide. A full-height light grey panel (left 0 to 37.6% of width, from 16.9% to the bottom edge) holds the left column: a bold purple subheading, three stacked statistics separated by thin rules, and an award-badge box. The right column holds a centred purple header with a rule beneath it, above a 2-by-3 grid of grey tiles surrounding a circular photo montage. The title sits top-left at about 6.8% from the top with the GE HealthCare logo top-right; footnotes sit bottom-left, the copyright line bottom-centre-right and the page number 43 at bottom-right (about 94.8% across, 95% down), with roughly 3% side margins.

**Visuals**

1) Circular photo montage (about 21.6% by 38.5% of slide) at the centre of the 2-by-3 grid: a circle split into four quadrants. Top-left: a blue-toned wireframe render of an imaging machine (MRI or X-ray system) with a red ECG-style trace and small cyan text, dark navy background. Top-right: a smiling man with glasses and a dark blue shirt working at a keyboard in a desaturated photo, dark background. Bottom-left: a technician in a light blue shirt bending over a machine with a white cloth, in a warm, neutral-toned photo. Bottom-right: a close-up of a blue-lit medical camera or detector device on a dark blue background. A thin dark navy ring (about 1px) encircles the montage and is partly hidden behind the tiles.
2) Six light grey tiles (#DBE2E9) arranged 2 columns by 3 rows around the circle, each with centred black text as listed in elements.
3) Left panel: three large statistics in bold navy, with thin dark grey rules between them.
4) Award badges (three, in a white box with a thin light grey outline): each is a circular seal with an orange outer ring and white centre, an imv logo at the top, a blue ribbon banner across the middle with white bold label, the ServiceTrak wordmark in blue, a small star icon between 2020 and 2021, and a caption below in small caps with 'GE Healthcare' in bold blue. Badge 1 label 'CT', 2021 BEST SERVICE WINNER; badge 2 label 'INTERVENTIONAL X-RAY', 2021 BEST CUSTOMER SATISFACTION WINNER; badge 3 label 'PET', 2021 BEST SERVICE WINNER. Badges are full-colour (orange, blue, white) on a white ground and are not cropped.
5) GE HealthCare logo, top right: a purple circular monogram with white 'GE'-style script symbol, and the wordmark 'GE HealthCare' in purple sans-serif.
6) Thin horizontal rules: one under the left statistic 1 (about 38.8% down, about 2.8% to 38.2% across), one under statistic 2 (about 52% down), and one under the right header (about 27.3% down, from about 41% to 89.5% across), all dark grey, about 1px.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Left panel light grey-blue #DBE2E9 at about 42% opacity (reads as about #F3F5F8). Titles and section headings in purple #640ACD. Statistic numerals and the badge-caption accent in dark navy #002A5C. Body and stat labels in navy #0C2340. Tile text and footer in black #000000. Accent blue in the badges is about #1A73BE with orange rings about #F28C1E. Typeface: Arial (ArialMT) regular for the title and body, Arial Bold for the subheading and the big statistics. Title size about 5.2% of slide height (approximately cap height 3.6%). Subheading and body text about 2.6% (approximately 2.6%). Tile labels about 3.0%. Footer and footnotes about 1.5%. Shapes are square-cornered rectangles with no shadows, no gradients, and no rounded corners. The grey tiles have no outline. Rules are thin dark grey lines.

### Slide 44

**Text**

Imaging Historical Financial Summary / GE HealthCare / Revenue / Key Drivers / Service / Revenue / $9.1B / $9.0B / $9.4B / $7.0B / $7.3B / 2019A / 2020A / 2021A / 2021 Q3 YTD / 2022 Q3 YTD / Segment EBIT Margin / 10.3% / 13.2% / 13.1% / 13.2% / 10.7% / 2019A / 2020A / 2021A / 2021 Q3 YTD / 2022 Q3 YTD / Customer Insights Driving Innovation / Edison-enabled AI & Connectivity / Large Installed Base with Upgrades & Service / YTD Margin Compression As Pricing Flows Through / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 44

**Layout**

Two-column slide on a white field: a wide left column (about 4 to 50 percent of slide width) holds two stacked bar charts, each under a centred bold purple heading with a thin dark rule beneath; a narrower right column (about 52 to 100 percent) sits on a light blue-grey panel with the 'Key Drivers' heading and four checkmark bullets. The title sits top left at about 6.8 percent from the top, with the GE HealthCare logo top right; the copyright line sits bottom right inside the panel and the page number 44 sits at the far bottom right corner.

**Visuals**

Chart 1, Revenue (column chart): title 'Revenue'; categories 2019A, 2020A, 2021A, 2021 Q3 YTD, 2022 Q3 YTD; values printed above bars $9.1B, $9.0B, $9.4B, $7.0B, $7.3B (units billions of US dollars); no printed axis or axis range; bars drawn to a common baseline with about equal scale. Bar colours left to right: light cyan #59CBE8, navy #002D5D, light grey-blue #BFCBD8, light lilac #C08FFA, violet #640ACD. A yellow #FFC000 dashed rectangle outlines the lower part of each bar and a callout labelled 'Service Revenue' with a yellow dashed border sits at the left of the 2019A bar, indicating the service revenue portion. A dashed lilac #C08FFA vertical divider separates the annual bars from the 2021 Q3 YTD and 2022 Q3 YTD bars. Chart 2, Segment EBIT Margin (column chart): title 'Segment EBIT Margin'; categories 2019A, 2020A, 2021A, 2021 Q3 YTD, 2022 Q3 YTD; values printed above bars 10.3%, 13.2%, 13.1%, 13.2%, 10.7% (percent, no printed axis or range); same five bar colours as chart 1; same dashed lilac vertical divider between 2021A and 2021 Q3 YTD. Legend: none. Highlighted points: none beyond the yellow service-revenue outlines. Icons: five circular checkmark icons in violet #640ACD (one per bullet, outline circle with bold check), drawn with stroke about 0.3 percent of slide width. Logo: GE HealthCare logo (circular GE monogram in violet with wordmark 'GE HealthCare' in violet) top right, not cropped.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a light blue-grey panel #DBE2E9 at 50 percent opacity covering the right column. Title colour violet #640ACD, body and bullet text violet #640ACD bold, chart value labels near black #0D0D0D, axis labels black #000000, footer grey-black. Accent colours: violet #640ACD, lilac #C08FFA, cyan #59CBE8, navy #002D5D, light grey-blue #BFCBD8, yellow #FFC000 for dashed highlights. Typefaces: title in Arial regular (sans-serif, not bold), section headings and bullets in Arial Bold (sans-serif), chart values and axis labels in Arial regular (sans-serif). Title text is about 5.2 percent of slide height, section headings about 3.0 percent, bullets about 2.9 percent, chart labels about 2.6 percent, axis labels about 2.2 percent, footer about 1.6 percent. Rules are thin dark grey lines about 0.1 percent of height. Bars are flat with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners; dashed outlines are about 0.2 percent stroke.

### Slide 51

**Text**

Industry-Leading Ultrasound Portfolio / Spanning the Continuum of Care Including Screening-a), Diagnosis, Treatment and Follow-up / New Growth Areas / Radiology and Primary Care / Cardiovascular / Women’s Health / Point of Care & Handheld / Surgical Visualization & Guidance / Industry-b) / ~$3B / ~$1B / ~$1B / ~$1B / ~$1B / Estimated Growth-c) / ~4-6% / ~3-5% / ~3-5% / ~8-10% / ~10%+ / Versana / LOGIQ / Vivid / Voluson / Vscan Air / Venue / bkActiv / Product Portfolio Supported by Growing Demand for Digital Solutions and Service Capabilities / Source: GE HealthCare Estimates / (a - Invenia ABUS or *Automated Breast Ultrasound / (b - For the year 2021, Form 10 sub-segments and industry / (c - For the period 2022-2025, Form 10 CAGR / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 51

**Layout**

A full-width table-style grid with a title block at top left (title and subtitle left-aligned at x 4.1 to 4.2 percent, y 6.8 and 12.3 percent) and the GE HealthCare logo at top right. Five product columns sit under a purple header band spanning x 2.6 to 98 percent; the two right-hand columns (Point of Care and Handheld, Surgical Visualization and Guidance) sit on a light grey-blue panel labelled New Growth Areas above the header. Rows run Industry, a horizontal rule, Estimated Growth, then product images with names. A navy banner sits at y 85.3 percent, with source footnotes bottom-left and copyright centred-right and page number at bottom right at about x 94.8 percent.

**Visuals**

Table-style infographic with 5 columns and 3 data rows plus product images. Header row (white text on purple): Radiology and Primary Care; Cardiovascular; Women’s Health; Point of Care & Handheld; Surgical Visualization & Guidance. Row Industry-b): ~$3B; ~$1B; ~$1B; ~$1B; ~$1B. Row Estimated Growth-c): ~4-6%; ~3-5%; ~3-5%; ~8-10%; ~10%+. Product row: Radiology and Primary Care column shows Versana (portrait ultrasound cart, white and grey, with a dark monitor showing a grey ultrasound image, centred near x 9.7 percent) and LOGIQ (dark grey and white compact ultrasound cart on casters, landscape format, centred near x 17 percent). Cardiovascular shows Vivid (white cart with a tall monitor displaying cardiac images and a red highlighted spot, and a dark control panel, on casters) at x 26.8 percent. Women’s Health shows Voluson (white and grey cart with a monitor displaying a colour fetal image) at x 47.8 percent. Point of Care & Handheld shows Vscan Air (white handheld probe with a blue light strip, next to a phone-style screen showing a grey ultrasound image with blue vessel overlay and a small blue icon) at x 62 percent, and Venue (white and black portable cart with a monitor showing a waveform) at x 72.5 percent. Surgical Visualization and Guidance shows bkActiv (white mobile stand with a dark top monitor and a dark screen on a grey base) at x 86.1 percent. Product images are full-colour product photographs on white, cut out with no border, lit evenly from the front, with soft grey shadows beneath. No charts, no photographs of people.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in ArialMT-style regular sans-serif, purple #640ACD, roughly 5.2 percent of slide height for the cap-height line. Subtitle in the same family and colour at about 3.3 percent. Header row text in white #FFFFFF, Arial regular with wide letter-spacing, about 3.0 percent. Row labels and values in black #000000 Arial regular about 2.6 to 3.0 percent. Product names in dark blue #004187 Arial regular about 2.6 percent. New Growth Areas label in navy #002D5D about 2.5 percent. Banner text white bold Arial about 3.0 percent. Footnotes black Arial regular about 1.5 percent. Accents: purple #640ACD header band and title, light grey-blue #DBE2E9 panel, navy #002D5D banner. Shapes are flat rectangles with square corners and no shadows; a thin dark grey rule divides the Industry row from Estimated Growth. Dense, corporate, flat design.

Lighting is soft and even, and the dominant colours are white, grey, beige and wood brown. Screenshot (right, boxed, not cropped, black background): an ultrasound interface with three grey fan-shaped B-mode fetal head images, arranged top-left, top-right and bottom-left, with small orange and red arrow markers and a green A/B/C crosshair in the centre. Three pictures and one logo. The title sits top-left at about 6.8% from the top, the GE HealthCare logo sits top-right, each section heading is centred over a thin rule, the copyright footer sits bottom-centre of the right panel and the page number sits bottom-right at the slide edge.

**Visuals**

Two vertical bar charts, each with five categories (2019A, 2020A, 2021A, 2021 3Q YTD, 2022 3Q YTD) and a dashed vertical lilac divider between 2021A and 2021 3Q YTD. Chart 1 is titled Revenue, has no visible y-axis or axis units, and its bars are labelled in US dollars billions: 2019A $2.8B, 2020A $2.7B, 2021A $3.2B, 2021 3Q YTD $2.3B, 2022 3Q YTD $2.5B. Bar heights are proportional to these values, with 2021A the tallest bar. Chart 2 is titled Segment EBIT Margin, has no visible y-axis, and its bars are labelled as percentages: 2019A 23.4%, 2020A 23.7%, 2021A 27.9%, 2021 3Q YTD 26.7%, 2022 3Q YTD 25.3%. Bar colours per category are the same in both charts: 2019A light cyan #59CBE8, 2020A navy #002D5D, 2021A pale grey-blue #BFCBD8, 2021 3Q YTD lavender #C08FFA, 2022 3Q YTD violet #640ACD. Each chart has a thin light grey horizontal baseline under the bars. There is no legend; the category labels serve as the key. No points are highlighted beyond the divider. Five check-mark icons: each is a purple circular outline with a bold purple check mark, placed at the left of each Key Drivers item. Logo: GE HealthCare logo, a purple circular monogram with the letters GE in a stylised form, followed by the purple wordmark GE HealthCare, placed top-right. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: White #FFFFFF, with a light grey-blue panel #DBE2E9 at 50% opacity covering the right side from x 52.1% to the right edge. Clean corporate slide. Background is white with a light grey-blue right-hand panel. Title colour violet #640ACD in regular-weight Arial-style sans-serif, about 5.2% of slide height. Section headings (Revenue, Segment EBIT Margin, Key Drivers) are bold Arial in violet #640ACD at about 3.0% of slide height, centred over thin dark grey rules (about #3A3A3A, 0.75 pt). Chart value labels and category labels are regular Arial in near-black #0D0D0D at about 2.2 to 2.6% of slide height. Key Drivers items are bold Arial in violet #640ACD at about 3.0% of slide height. Footer is regular Arial, grey, about 1.6% of slide height. Accent palette: cyan #59CBE8, navy #002D5D, grey-blue #BFCBD8, lavender #C08FFA, violet #640ACD. Bars have square corners and no shadows; the dashed divider is lilac #C08FFA, dashed, about 1.5 pt. Right panel has no border, opacity 50 percent over white.
