**Layout**

A single full-width wide-screen slide with a white header band holding the title at top left and the GE HealthCare logo at top right, a full-bleed dark dotted-wave image band across the middle, and a white footer strip. Four equal-width columns sit on a horizontal timeline at about 49% of slide height, each with a centred icon above the timeline dot and a centred caption below. The copyright line is at lower right and the slide number at far right of the footer.

**Visuals**

Four white line icons on the dark band, plus a purple logo and a full-bleed photograph-style illustration. (1) Bar chart icon: a white outline of three filled white bars rising left to right with an upward arrow above, inside an L-shaped axis frame, at about x 10.7 y 34.0 w 5.3 h 9.6. (2) Hub icon: a white ring circle at the centre with eight white arrows pointing outward (up, down, left, right and four diagonals), at about x 33.6 y 31.7 w 8.0 h 14.1. (3) Digital icon cluster: a large white-outlined circle (about x 60.7 y 34.0 w 6.0 h 10.6) containing a white ultrasound-scanner outline inside a square frame; a smaller white-outlined circle top-left (about x 56.9 y 32.6 w 3.0 h 5.2) containing a microphone outline; and a smaller white-outlined circle below it (about x 56.9 y 40.9 w 3.0 h 5.1) containing a mobile phone outline. (4) Light-bulb icon: a white outlined bulb containing a gear, with rays around it and three base lines, at about x 82.2 y 32.9 w 6.9 h 12.9. Timeline: a 2-point-thick white horizontal line from x 4.2 to x 95.7 at y 49.4 ending in a small white arrowhead at the right; four purple filled circles with white centres sit on the line at x about 13.2, 37.4, 61.6 and 85.7 (centre y 49.9), each about 3.5 percent of slide width in diameter. Photograph/illustration: a full-width dark navy-to-black background with glowing magenta and violet dot-matrix wave ribbons sweeping diagonally, forming an X crossing near the centre, with scattered small white digits and characters in the dark areas; the image is not cropped in a visible way, sits boxed at y 17.3 to 89.7 full width, and has a black overlay at 30 percent opacity over it. Logo: the GE HealthCare logo at top right (x 80.0 y 4.2 w 17.0 h 10.3): a purple circular monogram with the GE letters in a stylised knot, followed by the words GE HealthCare in purple lowercase sans-serif, with GE in bold.

**Design**

Background: Full-slide white #FFFFFF, with a dark navy-to-black dotted-wave photograph band (approx. #0A0A1E with magenta and violet highlights) across the middle at 17 to 90 percent of height under a 30 percent black overlay. Clean corporate look: white top and bottom bands framing a dark, glowing purple-and-magenta dotted-wave hero band. Background is white (#FFFFFF) outside the hero; the hero is near-black navy (#0A0A1E) with magenta (#C2188F-like) and violet (#5A1BD6-like) wave dots under a 30 percent black overlay. Title colour is purple #640ACD. Body text is white #FFFFFF. Accent colour is purple #640ACD for title, logo, and timeline nodes. Typeface is an Arial-style neo-grotesque sans-serif (ArialMT) in regular weight; title is about 5.2 percent of slide height and caption text about 3.3 percent. A thin light grey rule (#BFBFBF-like) lies along the top edge of the hero band. Timeline line is white, about 0.3 percent of height thick, with a small triangular arrowhead. Nodes are solid purple circles with white centres and no shadow. Icons are white monoline outlines about 0.2 percent of height thick. No corner radii, shadows or gradients on text; the hero has a soft glow on the wave ribbons.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about 4 percent from the left edge, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right. A full-width light grey-blue band occupies the middle of the slide and holds a five-column grid of tiles in two rows, with a small gap between tiles. Footnotes sit bottom-left, the copyright line bottom-centre-right and the page number bottom-right, all below the band on white.

**Visuals**

Four photographs and one product image sit in the grid. Top row, column 3: a photograph of a clinician in navy scrubs and a blue surgical cap at an anaesthesia workstation with several monitors (one showing a green 61 readout), touching a screen, with a patient lying on a bed in the lower left under a blue drape and an IV pole at top left; teal-green wall tiles behind; cool clinical light; dominant colours teal, navy and white; boxed rectangle, not cropped to a shape, no overlay. Top row, column 5: a close photograph of a bare upper arm with a blue rectangular sensor and white adhesive electrode pads attached; warm skin tones, blurred indoor background, dark sleeve at top; boxed, no overlay. Bottom row, column 1: a photograph taken from behind of a clinician in a dark navy cap and scrubs and blue gloves operating a wall-mounted touchscreen monitor showing coloured ECG waveform traces and numeric readouts; blue-tinted screen, dark navy clothing; boxed, no overlay. Bottom row, column 3: a product photograph on a white background of a black patient monitor with a large flat screen showing a multi-panel grid of coloured ECG waveforms (red, yellow, blue, green traces) with numeric values, a GE logo on the bezel below the screen, a black keyboard and a black mouse in front; shown on white, unboxed. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey-blue band #DBE2E9 spanning full width behind the tile grid. Slide background is white in the header and footer zones with a light grey-blue band #DBE2E9 behind the tile grid. Title is purple #640ACD in regular sans-serif (Arial-like), about 5.2 percent of slide height. Tile text is white regular sans-serif (Arial-like), about 3 percent of slide height for body and 4.4 percent for large figures. Tile fills are purple #640ACD, dark navy #0C2340, and one deep violet #320567 behind the sensor photograph. Footnotes and copyright are black #000000 regular sans-serif at about 1.5 percent of slide height. Tiles are square-cornered with no shadows, no gradients and no borders.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about 4% from the left edge and 7% from the top, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right. A left column holds a tall dashed-outlined photo panel (about 7% to 23.5% across, 32% to 92.4% down) with a bold message box over it. To its right is a four-row grid of photo-and-label tiles (about 27.6% to 59.7% across), with four check-mark columns on the far right (about 62% to 89% across) under four icon headers. The footer copyright sits bottom-right at about 57% across with the page number at about 95% across, bottom edge near 96%. Margins are about 4% left and 5% right.

**Visuals**

Four small line icons in grey-blue above the check columns: (1) an ambulance with a red-cross emblem, labelled Stabilize & Triage; (2) an IV drip stand with a bag and tubing, labelled Surgical Care; (3) a patient monitor showing an ECG trace, labelled Critical Care; (4) a stethoscope with a medical cross, labelled Monitoring & Observation. Under each icon is a dark slate-blue dot (#56718C). Dotted light-grey vertical column dividers (#BFBFBF) run from about 32.7% to 92.4% down at about 67.3%, 74.7%, 82.2% and 89.6% across. Purple check marks (#640ACD, Wingdings check): Monitoring Solutions row has checks in all four columns; Anesthesia & Respiratory Care row has checks in columns 2, 3 and 4; Diagnostic Cardiology row has checks in all four columns; Maternal Infant Care row has checks in columns 3 and 4. Four left-pointing purple gradient arrows (#640ACD fading to transparent toward the right) sit between the photo panel and the tiles at the heights of rows 1 to 4. Photo panel (left, full height of the dashed box): top third is a wide wall of blue-tinted monitor screens displaying data grids, middle third is a blurred room with a clinician and screens under a white translucent veil, bottom is a close view of a pale grey medical cabinet with drawers, cropped and tinted cool blue-white. Row 1 photo: a clinician in dark cap and navy top seen from behind, viewing a patient monitor with bright waveforms, dark background, cool lighting. Row 2 photo: an operating room with surgical staff in blue gowns and masks around a patient on a table, medical equipment and monitors around, bright overhead light. Row 3 photo: an older male patient lying in a hospital bed under a white blanket, with a nurse in blue scrubs and a ponytail beside him, warm beige hospital room, soft lighting. Row 4 photo: a newborn lying on its back in a clear, rounded incubator, white and beige tones, soft diffuse light. Photos are rectangular, unrounded and not cropped beyond their frames.

**Layout**

Two-column grid under a title row: a narrow grey left panel (about 35% of width) holds the chart section, and a wider white right area (about 37% to 96% of width) holds two stacked boxed lists with purple headings and thin dark grey rules above each. Title sits top-left at about 7% from the top edge, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right. Left-aligned text with about 4% left margin; copyright line and page number sit in the bottom footer band, page number at bottom-right; footnotes sit bottom-left under the chart.

**Visuals**

Column chart, no chart title beyond the section heading Estimated End Market Sizes-a). Categories on the horizontal axis: 2021A and 2025E, labelled beneath the baseline. No vertical axis, no axis range or units printed. Series (single series, bars drawn to scale): 2021A bar labelled $18B, light cyan #59CBE8; 2025E bar labelled $21B -c), dark navy #002B5D. No legend. No points highlighted apart from a purple #640ACD diagonal arrow rising from the top of the 2021A bar to the top of the 2025E bar, indicating growth. Callout box above the chart reading $18B end markets: 3-6% CAGR-b) and Digital solutions growing +10%. Footnotes a, b, c as listed in text. Right side: an icon panel with three icons beside Numerous Macro Trends items: a cyan wheelchair/patient ring icon for Aging, clinically complex population; a navy stethoscope ring icon for Clinician shortages; a blue hand-with-exclamation ring icon for Inflationary pressure stressing healthcare viability. Lower icon panel with three icons beside unmet needs: a green hospital building ring icon for Connected and seamless data; a purple group-of-people with monitor ring icon for Real-time visualization; a grey patient-in-chair ring icon for Workflow improvements with clinical decision support. Logo: GE HealthCare logo at top-right, purple circular GE monogram with the wordmark GE HealthCare in purple.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a pale grey-blue panel #DBE2E9 at 42% opacity behind the left column. White slide background with a pale blue-grey panel #DBE2E9 at 42% opacity behind the left column (appears about #F1F3F7). Titles and section headings purple #640ACD; body text black #000000; chart value labels near-black #0D0D0D. Accents: purple #640ACD arrow and rules, cyan #59CBE8 and navy #002B5D bars. Typefaces: title in Arial regular sans-serif; section headings in Arial Bold; body in Arial regular. Title height about 5.2% of slide height (cap height about 3.6%); body text about 2.96% of slide height; footnotes and footer about 1.5%. Thin dark grey horizontal rules under the right headings. White boxes with very faint drop shadows behind the two icon lists. Callout box has a thin dark grey 1px outline with square corners. No gradients; flat fills.

**Layout**

Single-slide content layout on a white field with the title top-left at about 4% margin and the GE HealthCare logo top-right. A full-width gradient chevron header band sits below the title, split into 'Industry Firsts' (left) and 'Innovation Pipeline' (right). Below it, a two-column layout: left column holds the Command Center photo and the MUSE EKG Management image stacked with the ALIVECOR logo beneath; right column holds a lavender legend panel above a purple year-header bar and three table rows of row labels and icon grid separated by thin grey rules. A full-width navy takeaway band sits near the bottom, followed by the copyright line at lower right and page number 63 at far right.

**Visuals**

Photograph 1 (Command Center): a woman with long brown hair seen from behind, wearing a blue top, seated at a desk typing on a keyboard in front of multiple computer monitors displaying blue-toned dashboards; a second person is visible in the background and large wall screens are in the upper portion; shot from behind and slightly to the side at eye level; cool blue monitor light with soft daylight from windows at right; dominant colours blue, white and grey; full rectangular frame, not cropped, not boxed with border. Photograph 2 (MUSE EKG Management): a close-up of a wrist wearing a dark wearable device with a hand touching its screen; circular magnifier insets show a clinician in a white coat with a tablet at top and a close view of the device screen at bottom-right; large white caption text 'Precision Monitoring' overlays the right side; dark navy and blue tones with grey-white highlights; cool lighting; rectangular frame, not cropped. Logo: GE HealthCare logo, purple circular monogram with white GE mark and purple wordmark 'GE HealthCare'. Logo: ALIVECOR wordmark in dark teal-green uppercase with a stylised A. Icon: white line-art hospital building with a cross on its roof and grid of windows, at top-right of the header band. Icon grid: purple filled circles with light lavender halo rings and purple solid bookmark-shaped flags, in a 4-column by 3-row grid under 2022 to 2025 headers. Row 1 Monitoring & Digital Solutions: 2022 one circle then one bookmark; 2023 one circle then one bookmark; 2024 two circles; 2025 two circles. Row 2 Anesthesia & Respiratory: 2022 one circle; 2023 one bookmark; 2024 one circle; 2025 one bookmark. Row 3 Diagnostic Cardiology: 2022 one circle; 2023 one bookmark; 2024 one circle; 2025 one bookmark. Legend: purple circle = Major NPI (Innovation); purple bookmark = Other Programs (Iterations). Dividers: three thin grey horizontal rules spanning the right table area. Chevron gradients: left band from pale lavender at left edge to deep purple at its point; right band from pale lavender to violet at its right tip.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the full slide. White background. Titles and header text in violet/purple: slide title #640ACD; section 'Command Center' and 'MUSE EKG Management' labels #640ACD in GEInspira-style sans. Chevron header: left chevron gradient from light lavender (#E3D2FB) to deep purple #4B089A; right chevron gradient from pale lilac (#D9B8FB) to violet (#640ACD); section labels in white Arial. Lavender panel #DFC7FC at 41 percent opacity behind legend and table header. Year header bar #4B089A with white Arial year labels. Row labels bold Arial in dark navy #0C2340. Legend and table title text black #000000 in Arial. Takeaway band navy #002D5D with bold white Arial text. Footer copyright and page number black Arial. Title is Arial regular, about 5.2 percent of slide height; body labels about 2.2 to 2.6 percent of slide height; takeaway band text about 3.3 percent; footer about 1.6 percent. Icons and bullets: flat solid purple #640ACD with pale lavender halo rings; sharp-cornered bookmark flags. Divider rules thin grey #7F7F7F, about 0.1 percent of height. No shadows; gradients only on chevrons.

**Layout**

Two-column slide on a white field. The left column (about 0 to 49% of width) holds two stacked vertical bar charts, Revenue on top and Segment EBIT Margin below, each with a bold centred heading and a thin grey rule beneath. The right column (about 52 to 100% of width) sits on a light grey panel that starts at the top rule level and runs to the footer; it holds the bold Key Drivers heading with a rule and three checkmarked driver statements at about 25%, 45% and 66% of slide height. The title is top-left at about 7% from the top and 4% from the left margin; the GE HealthCare logo is top-right. A full-width navy bar spans the slide at about 86% to 93% height, with the tagline centred in it. The copyright line sits bottom-right under the panel and the page number is at the bottom-right corner, about 95% down.

**Visuals**

Chart 1, Revenue: vertical column chart, title Revenue. No axis lines with values or units are printed; the baseline is a thin light grey horizontal line. Five columns in reading order with printed data labels: 2019A $2.7B in light blue, 2020A $3.7B in navy, 2021A $2.9B in pale grey-blue, 2021 Q3 YTD $2.2B in lavender, 2022 Q3 YTD $2.1B in purple. A dashed lavender vertical divider sits between 2021A and 2021 Q3 YTD, separating full-year actuals from year-to-date periods. No legend. No highlighted points beyond the colour coding. Chart 2, Segment EBIT Margin: vertical column chart with the same five categories and the same colours and divider. Printed labels: 2019A 9.7%, 2020A 19.0%, 2021A 12.2%, 2021 Q3 YTD 12.2%, 2022 Q3 YTD 9.9%. No axis values or units beyond the percent labels. No legend. Icons: three identical circular checkmark icons in purple outline, one beside each Key Drivers statement. Logo: GE HealthCare logo at top right, a purple circular GE monogram followed by the purple wordmark GE HealthCare. Shapes: a light grey panel on the right half and a navy full-width tagline bar.

**Design**

Background white with a light grey-blue panel (#F1F3F6, the light grey #DBE2E9 at 42% opacity) behind the right column. Title and headings in purple #640ACD. Body and driver text in purple #640ACD for the driver statements, black #000000 for bullets, #0D0D0D for data labels. Accents: navy #002B5D for 2020A bars and the tagline bar; light blue #59CBE8; pale grey-blue #BFCBD8; lavender #C08FFA; purple #640ACD. Typefaces: title in a regular Arial-style sans-serif at about 5.2% of slide height; section headings and driver statements in Arial Bold, about 3.0% of slide height; chart labels and bullets in Arial regular, about 2.2 to 2.6%; tagline in Arial Bold white, about 3.3%; footer in Arial regular about 1.6%. ### Slide 67

**Review notes**

- Suggested repair: Increase text size and thin out the dense pages on 22, 37 to 42 and 62 to 66, fix the cramped line spacing in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and put values on the waterfall steps on slides 45, 67 and 95.

**Text**

Visible Path to EBIT Margin Expansion / GE HealthCare / High-teens / ~10-12%-a) / Recent Historical / Segment EBIT / Margin Range / NPIs & / Services / Price & / Commercial / Execution / VCP & / Platforming / Digital / Medium-Term / Target / (a - Excludes 2020 due to COVID impact / Note: Illustrative graph, not to scale / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 67

**Layout**

Single-slide waterfall-style chart on a white field. The title sits top-left at the same height as the GE HealthCare logo, which is top-right. The chart spans the full content width between about 4% and 93% of slide width, sitting on a thin horizontal baseline at about 77.5% of slide height. Category labels are centred under each bar in three-line bold blocks. The footnotes sit bottom-left, the copyright line bottom-centre-right and the page number bottom-right, all on one baseline band near 95%.

**Visuals**

One chart, a waterfall-style bar chart with an overlaid curved arrow, shown as a raster image 2380 by 1022 pixels. Chart title: none; the slide title serves as the heading. Axes: no printed axis, no scale, no tick values; the note says Illustrative graph, not to scale. Baseline: a thin light grey horizontal line at the bottom of the bars, from about x 3.9% to 93.4%. Series, left to right: (1) Recent Historical Segment EBIT Margin Range, a single lilac bar labelled about 10-12% with superscript -a), height about 21% of slide height, from baseline up to about 56.4% of slide height; (2) NPIs & Services, a floating dark slate bar spanning about 43.2% to 56.4% of slide height, x 20.6% to 32.9%; (3) Price & Commercial Execution, a floating dark slate bar about 37.2% to 43.2% of slide height, x 35.4% to 47.5%; (4) VCP & Platforming, a floating dark slate bar about 31.8% to 35.2% of slide height, x 50.0% to 62.2%; (5) Digital, a floating dark slate bar about 26.8% to 30.8% of slide height, x 64.7% to 76.9%; (6) Medium-Term Target, a solid saturated violet bar labelled High-teens, x 79.4% to 91.6%, top at about 26.8% of slide height. No values are printed for the floating bars; their heights are not labelled. Highlighted points: the two end bars are highlighted, the start bar in pale lilac and the target bar in saturated violet, while the middle steps are dark slate. Legend: none. Overlay: a pale grey curved arrow with a triangular head at upper right, rising from the lower left of the first floating bar at about x 22.6% and y 77.5% to a tip at about x 77.2% and y 37%, passing behind the floating bars. The arrow is a translucent shape filled #95A9BE at 20% opacity, which renders as a very light grey.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. Plain white background with no gradient, texture or shadows. Title in Arial regular, purple #640ACD, sentence case, roughly 5.2% of slide height. Chart labels in Arial bold, black #000000, about 3.0% of slide height for the category labels and 2.6% for the value labels. Footnotes and copyright in Arial regular, black #000000, about 1.5% of slide height. Bars are flat fills with no outlines: lilac #C18FF7, dark slate #343F48, violet #6209D0. Arrow is light grey #E8EBEF on white (from #95A9BE at 20% opacity). Baseline is a hairline light grey. Corners are square; no rounded corners.

**Layout**

Two-column slide under a single-line title at the top left. The left column is a narrow grey panel (about 35% of the width, full height from just below the title to the bottom edge) holding a bordered callout box, a two-bar chart and footnotes. The right column holds a bold section heading with a thin grey rule beneath it, then a white card with four stacked icon-and-text rows, left-aligned at the same x. The title is left aligned at about 4% from the left edge and the GE HealthCare logo sits at its right end. The copyright line sits at the bottom right of the right column and the page number is at the bottom right corner, both at about 95% of the height.

**Visuals**

Bar chart (column chart, no title, no y-axis, no gridlines). Two columns on a thin grey baseline at about 84% of the height: a light cyan column labelled $10B above it for 2021A (actual) and a navy column labelled $12B-b) above it for 2025E (estimate). The 2025E column is about 2.8 times the height of the 2021A column relative to the baseline, consistent with the labels. A purple arrow (about 1.5 pt, arrowhead at the upper end) runs diagonally from the top right of the 2021A column up to the top left of the 2025E column. No legend and no highlighted points beyond the arrow. Also four purple line icons in circular outlines in the right card, one per row: a heart with a pulse line on a monitor/tablet (therapies and diagnostics), a lungs inside a scan frame (contrast media), a wheelchair user (aging populations), and a hospital building with a cross on its roof (patient access). Plus the GE HealthCare logo: a purple circular monogram with stylised GE letters, followed by the purple GE HealthCare wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light blue-grey #DBE2E9 panel (about 42% opacity) covering the left column. Clean corporate look on a white slide. Left panel is light blue-grey at reduced opacity. The title is purple #640ACD in a regular-weight sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica style), about 5.2% of slide height. Section headings are bold purple #640ACD sans-serif (Arial Bold style) at about 3% of slide height. Body text is black #000000 regular sans-serif at about 3.3% of slide height, with the bar labels at about 2.6% and the footnotes and copyright at about 1.5%. Accents are purple #640ACD for icons, arrow and headings, cyan #59CBE8 and navy #0C2340 for the bars. The callout box has a thin dark navy #0C2340 1 pt outline, square corners, no fill beyond white. The right card is white with a very faint drop shadow and square corners. The divider rule under the right heading is a thin dark grey #595959 line, about 0.75 pt.

A three-column matrix with a two-row grid beneath a chevron header bar: column headers run across the top, row labels sit in a narrow left column, and the three content columns (administered to patient, amplified diagnostic images, enhanced clinical decisions) hold images and captions. (1) Column 1, row 1 (Contrast Media): photo of a CT scanner gantry (white and grey housing with open circular aperture) with a patient lying on the motorised table and a technician in blue scrubs beside it; the scanner is shown in a three-quarter angle on a white background, unboxed, with no overlay. (2) Column 1, row 2 (Molecular Imaging): photo of a PET/SPECT-style scanner (white rounded gantry with open aperture) with a patient on the bed and a doctor in a white coat standing at the right; white background, unboxed. (3) Column 2, row 1: two side-by-side greyscale-style angiographic images, a left grey image of a branching lung/airway vascular tree (white contrast-filled vessels on dark grey) about 78 by 82 px, and a right image of a brain with golden-yellow vessels on a dark purple-black background about 82 by 82 px; both are boxed squares with no border. (4) Column 2, row 2: two side-by-side functional scans, a left brain image in false-colour (red, yellow and green cortex on dark blue/purple) about 76 by 86 px, and a right coronal-style PET slice (two bright orange-red spots on teal-green) about 85 by 85 px; both boxed squares. (5) Column 3, row 1: full-width colour photo of a woman with curly dark hair seen in profile at right, working at a desk with several computer monitors displaying grey and blue medical brain and spine scans; cool blue and dark tones, lit by the monitor glow, rectangular and unboxed, about 728 by 420 px. (6) Column 3, row 2: photo of a bearded man with a hair bun seated at left and a smiling woman doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope holding a black clipboard at right, in a bright office with soft neutral background; warm natural light, rectangular, unboxed, about 727 by 362 px. (7) Hidden placed image of 161 by 107 px sits at the upper-left corner of the monitor photo and is not visible. **Layout**

Two-column layout on a white slide with the title top-left at about 6% from the top and the GE HealthCare logo top-right. The left column holds a bold section heading, three check-bulleted lines and an area chart; the right column sits on a light grey panel (x 53.6% to 99.9%, y 20.4% to 88.8%) containing a centred heading and three icon-plus-label rows (X-Ray, MRI, Ultrasound) each with two check bullets. The footer has a two-line source note bottom-left, a copyright line centred-right and the page number 75 at bottom-right near x 95%.

**Visuals**

Left: an illustrative area chart with no printed numeric values. Y-axis labelled VOLUME (no units or range printed) and x-axis labelled TIME running from Today to In ten years. A dark navy #133765 area fills the lower band labelled Market Production Capacity. Above it a pale blue-grey gradient wedge (#B9C6D5 fading to near white at the top right) rises diagonally from about the start of the axis to the top right and is labelled Demand in white rotated text. A white dashed line separates capacity from demand. A cyan double-headed vertical arrow at the right edge spans the gap between the top of the production area and the top of the demand wedge, labelled in cyan Investing to close the growing gap between supply and demand. Right panel: three monochrome navy line icons on white: an X-ray device icon, an MRI scanner icon (ring with bed), and an ultrasound scanner icon with a probe and sound waves. Each icon sits above or beside its bold navy label. Top-right: GE HealthCare purple monogram logo with wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a light grey-blue #DBE2E9 panel at about 42% opacity behind the right column. White background (#FFFFFF). Right panel light grey-blue #DBE2E9 at about 42% opacity, appearing as roughly #F1F3F7, with no border. Titles in purple #640ACD, regular Arial-style sans-serif for the main title, bold Arial-style for section headings (about 3.0% of slide height) and the strategy heading. Body text in black #000000 Arial-style regular at about 2.6% of slide height. Row labels X-Ray, MRI and Ultrasound are bold navy #002B5D at about 3.3%. Accent cyan #1DAFD3 for the chart annotation. Grey #7F7F7F for axis end labels. Thin grey horizontal rules (#7F7F7F, about 1 pt) under the two section headings. Check bullets use Wingdings check marks in black. No shadows, no rounded corners, no gradients other than the demand wedge.

**Layout**

Three equal-width columns of equal height sit side by side below a single-line title at the top left, with the GE HealthCare logo at the top right. Each column has a purple header bar, a dark slate subheader bar, and a light grey panel holding an image and bulleted text. A full-width navy banner sits near the bottom, above a two-line source footnote, a copyright line and the page number at the bottom right.

**Visuals**

Four images and one logo. **Layout**

Full-bleed white slide with the title top-left at about 4% from the left edge and 7% from the top, and the GE HealthCare logo top-right (x 80 to 97). A Gantt-style grid below: left block holds care-area boxes (x 4 to 19) and program boxes (x 20 to 41), and the right block (x 41 to 100) holds five phase columns with a grey header band, dotted column dividers and horizontal progress bars. A full-width navy banner sits at y 85.6 to 92.6 carrying the bold white takeaway line, with a small note at bottom-left, copyright line at bottom-centre-right and page number at bottom-right (x 94.8, y 95).

**Visuals**

Gantt-style pipeline chart with arrow-tipped horizontal bars. Columns, left to right: PRECLINICAL (starts at x 41.4), PHASE 1 (ends about x 62.7), PHASE 2 (ends about x 72.5), PHASE 3 (ends about x 82.8), MARKETING AUTHORIZATION (open-ended to right edge). Dotted light grey-blue vertical dividers at about x 41.2, 53.5, 62.8, 72.5 and 82.8, running from y 19 to y 93. Bars, top to bottom, all starting at the preclinical divider: Gd MR (Radiology, #320567 at 70% opacity, extends through Marketing Authorization, tip about x 87.8); Non-Gd MR (Radiology, extends to Phase 1 end, tip about x 62.7); Dopamine transporter PET (Neurology, tip about x 76.7, within Phase 3); Dopamine transporter SPECT (Neurology, tip about x 72.5, end of Phase 2 to Phase 3 boundary); Myocardial perfusion PET (Cardiology, tip about x 82.7, end of Phase 3); Estrogen receptor PET (Oncology, extends through Marketing Authorization, tip about x 87.8); Her2 receptor PET (Oncology, tip about x 62.7); CD8 T-Cells PET (Immuno-Diagnostics, dark grey bar tip about x 53.6, within Phase 1). Bar colours: purple #320567 for Radiology rows at 70% opacity, violet #640ACD for Neurology rows at 70% opacity, blue #1D559B for Cardiology at 70% opacity, cyan #59CBE8 for Oncology at 70% opacity, near-black #000000 at 70% opacity for Immuno-Diagnostics. No values, axes or legend; no highlighted points. Logo: GE HealthCare monogram (purple circle with stylised GE letters) followed by the purple wordmark GE HealthCare, #640ACD on white.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background; title and logo in violet #640ACD; column header band in slate #56718C with white uppercase text; care-area column headers in dark navy #0C2340; program header 'PROGRAM' in navy #0C2340. Title in Arial-style regular sans-serif, about 5.2% of slide height. Bar labels and box labels in white Arial regular, about 2.6% of slide height; the takeaway line is Arial Bold white about 3.3%. Care-area boxes are solid fills: Radiology #320567, Neurology #640ACD, Cardiology #1D559B, Oncology #59CBE8, Immuno-Diagnostics dark charcoal gradient from about #2A3038 to #111418. Program label boxes use the same family colours, flat with square corners and no shadows. Progress bars are flat, square-cornered rectangles with pointed chevron-style arrow tips, drawn at about 70% opacity. Dotted dividers are pale grey-blue #C9D3E0 approximately. Bottom banner is solid navy #002D5D with no border. Footer text is black Arial about 1.5% of slide height.

### Slide 78

**Text**

Pharmaceutical Diagnostics Historical Financial Summary / GE HealthCare / Revenue / $2.0B / $1.8B / $2.0B / $1.5B / $1.5B / 2019A / 2020A / 2021A / 2021 3Q YTD 2022 3Q YTD / Segment EBIT Margin / 34.9% / 28.3% / 34.3% / 36.5% / 27.7% / 2019A / 2020A / 2021A / 2021 3Q YTD 2022 3Q YTD / Key Drivers / Growing Procedural Demand Over Next Decade / Rise of Molecular Imaging / Strong Recurring Revenue and Margins / Theranostics Creating Growth Opportunity / © 2022, General Electric Company. Proprietary information. All rights reserved. / 78

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white slide: a left column holding two stacked bar charts (Revenue above, Segment EBIT Margin below) and a narrower right panel (starting at about 51.5% of the width, from 17.9% to the bottom) holding the Key Drivers list with check icons. The title sits top-left at about 6.8% from the top and the GE HealthCare logo sits top-right on the same line; the footer copyright and page number sit at the bottom of the right panel, bottom-right, at about 95% height.

**Visuals**

Two vertical bar charts and a list of four check-mark icons. Chart 1 is titled Revenue, a column chart with five categories on the x-axis (2019A, 2020A, 2021A, 2021 3Q YTD, 2022 3Q YTD) and values printed above each bar: 2019A $2.0B, 2020A $1.8B, 2021A $2.0B, 2021 3Q YTD $1.5B, 2022 3Q YTD $1.5B. No y-axis, no axis values or units beyond the $B labels, no legend; bars share a common baseline at about 48.8% of slide height. Bar colours left to right: 2019A light cyan #59CBE8, 2020A navy #002B5D, 2021A light grey-blue #BFCBD8, 2021 3Q YTD lavender #C08FFA, 2022 3Q YTD violet #640ACD. A dashed lavender #C08FFA vertical divider separates the full-year bars from the 3Q YTD bars. Chart 2 is titled Segment EBIT Margin, same five categories and same colours, with values printed above each bar: 2019A 34.9%, 2020A 28.3%, 2021A 34.3%, 2021 3Q YTD 36.5%, 2022 3Q YTD 27.7%; no y-axis, no legend, same dashed divider. Bars are heights proportional to the values as printed. Four check-mark icons: each is a purple #640ACD outlined circle with a bold check mark, placed to the left of each Key Drivers item. The GE HealthCare logo: a purple #640ACD circular monogram of the letters G and E in a stylised ring, followed by the wordmark GE HealthCare in purple #640ACD.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF background with a light grey-blue #F0F3F6 panel covering the right side from about 51.5% to the right edge and from 17.9% to the bottom. Clean corporate slide on white. Title and section headings are purple #640ACD; section headings are bold, title is regular weight. Body and chart value labels are near-black #0D0D0D; category labels are #0D0D0D. Accent colours are violet #640ACD, lavender #C08FFA, cyan #59CBE8, navy #002B5D and grey-blue #BFCBD8. Typefaces: title and category/value labels appear to be Arial regular (sans-serif); section headings and key driver items are Arial Bold (sans-serif). Title text is about 5.2% of slide height, section headings and key driver items about 3.0%, chart labels about 2.2 to 2.6%, footer and page number about 1.6%. Section headings are centred above thin dark grey #404040 horizontal rules, about 0.1% thick. The Key Drivers panel is a light blue-grey fill (#DBE2E9 at 42% opacity, resulting in about #F0F3F6) with square corners and no shadow. Chart baselines are light grey #D9D9D9 hairlines. No gradients, no shadows, no rounded corners on bars.

**Layout**

Single-column slide with a title at top left, a GE HealthCare logo at top right, a full-width dark wave band in the middle, and a footer row below the band. The title sits on the top margin at about 4% from the left edge. A horizontal white timeline runs across the band at about 46% of the slide height, with four evenly spaced columns of icon, node, and centred caption, spanning roughly 12% to 90% of the width. The copyright line is right-aligned to the page number at the bottom right, below the band on white.

**Visuals**

Four white line icons sit above the timeline, one per column. (1) Left: a cluster of three solid white cog gears of differing sizes, a large gear at lower left with two smaller gears upper right and top centre. (2) Second column: a white outline lightbulb with a gear inside it and a small magnifier-like detail, with short radiating rays at its upper corners. (3) Third column: a white outline test tube with a rounded bottom and a thick top rim, containing four small white bubbles. (4) Right: a white outline bar chart with three solid vertical bars of ascending height and a diagonal arrow pointing up and right above them, enclosed by an L-shaped white axis frame. The timeline is a 1.3% high white horizontal line from left to right, ending in a small white arrowhead at the right end. Four filled purple circles with white centres... more precisely, four purple (#640ACD) filled circles with white rings, sit on the line at about 19%, 39%, 61% and 82% of the width, each centred on the line. Behind everything is a photographic-style abstract wave graphic: a field of small magenta and violet dots forming two crossing sine-like ribbons that form an X-shaped crossing near the centre, with a dark navy background, faint small white digits scattered in the background. The wave image is full-bleed across the slide width and not cropped at the sides, and it is overlaid by a black tint at 30% opacity, which darkens it.

**Design**

Background: White (#FFFFFF) slide with a full-width dark wave photograph band (navy and magenta-violet, #000B1F to #C0148F) from about 17% to 90% of the slide height, tinted with 30% black. White slide background above and below a full-width dark band. The band uses a navy-to-black base (#000B1F-ish) with magenta #C0148F and violet #5A1BD6 dotted wave ribbons, darkened by a 30% black overlay. Title colour is purple #640ACD. Body captions and icons are white #FFFFFF. Accent nodes are purple #640ACD with white rings. Footer and page number are black #000000. Typeface is Arial (ArialMT) regular weight, a neo-grotesque sans-serif. Title is about 5.2% of slide height, captions are about 3.3%, and footer and page number are about 1.6%. Lines are flat, with no shadows, gradients on the shapes, or rounded corners beyond the circular nodes.

**Layout**

Title at top left, aligned to a left margin of about 4.2% of slide width, with the GE HealthCare logo at top right. Five horizontal banded rows fill the middle of the slide, each with an icon at left, a bold label in a left column starting at about 10% and a bullet description in a second column starting at about 40%. A full-width navy banner near the bottom carries a white bold takeaway line, with the copyright line and slide number in small type beneath it at the bottom right.

**Visuals**

Five line icons in dark navy, each one in the left column of its row: a handshake (row 1, Deep customer relationships), a globe with meridian and latitude lines (row 2, Tailored regional execution), a cloud with circuit-style connection nodes (row 3, Technology leader), a lightbulb with radiating rays (row 4, Solutions partner), and a crossed wrench and screwdriver (row 5, Best-in-class service). Icons are thin outline strokes of roughly 1 pt, with no fills. The GE HealthCare logo at top right is a purple circular GE monogram followed by the wordmark 'GE HealthCare' in purple. No photographs or charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in purple #640ACD, regular-weight Arial-like sans-serif, about 5.2% of slide height, with capitalised initial letters. Row labels in black #000000 bold Arial-like sans-serif, about 3.3% of slide height. Bullet descriptions in black #000000 regular Arial-like sans-serif, about 3.0% of slide height, with bullet character '•'. Alternating row bands in light grey-blue #DBE2E9 at about 47% opacity on rows 1, 3 and 5, with rows 2 and 4 white. Takeaway banner fill navy #002D5D with white bold text. Icons drawn in navy line style. Copyright and page number in black about 1.6% of slide height. Shapes are plain rectangles with square corners and no shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Two-column layout below a title: a left column titled Customer Needs (x 4.5 to 42.6%) with five icon-and-text rows, and a right column titled GE HealthCare Customer Team (x 43.3 to 97.3%) holding a navy donut ring with eight role labels around it. Title is top-left at y 6.8%, with the GE HealthCare logo top-right (x 80 to 97%). Column header bars sit at y 16.4 to 22.3%. A full-width navy footer band spans y 85.6 to 92.6% and carries the bold takeaway; copyright line bottom-left of the footer area and page number 84 bottom-right, both below the band. Left margin about 4.5%, right margin about 2.7%.

**Visuals**

Five outline line icons in navy #002D5D, stacked in the left column, each left of its text row: (1) a nurse or clinician figure with stethoscope, head-and-shoulders, centred at about x 6.5% y 27%; (2) a hospital building with a cross/asterisk sign on the facade, x 4.6 to 8.4%, y 36 to 42%; (3) a shield with an X mark, x 4.9 to 8.1%, y 47 to 53.5%; (4) a circled plus/cross, x 5 to 8.1%, y 60 to 65.6%; (5) a banknote with coins, x 4.75 to 8.3%, y 72 to 76.6%. In the right panel, a dark navy donut ring (#002D5D, about 28.7% wide, centred on the Customer label) surrounds a pale inner disc (#F0F3F6). Eight white circles with 1.5px light-blue #59CBE8 outlines sit on the ring, each with a navy line icon: Care Pathway Specialists (virus/cell icon), Product Sales Specialists (monitor with pen and cursor), Digital and Data Science Specialists (cloud with network nodes), Clinical Application Specialists (lightbulb with rays), Clinical Scientists (scientist with flask), Service Engineers (crossed wrench and screwdriver), Regional Managers (globe), Account Managers (handshake). Light-blue #59CBE8 connector lines run from each circle to a small dot on the inner edge of the ring, with the dots pointing toward the centre. The image panel is a pale grey-blue field (#DBE2E9 at about 31% opacity) behind the donut.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a purple title (#640ACD) in a regular sans-serif (Arial-like), about 5.2% of slide height. Column headers are solid purple #640ACD bars with white (#FFFFFF) regular sans-serif text about 3.3% of slide height. Body text is black #000000 regular Arial-like sans-serif about 3.0% of slide height. The 'Customer' centre label is black in a geometric sans (GE Inspira-style), about 5.2%. The footer takeaway is white bold Arial, about 3.3%, on a navy #002D5D band. Accents: purple #640ACD, light blue #59CBE8, navy #002D5D. Icons are thin navy line art. Shapes have square corners; no gradients; no visible drop shadows, though the ring has a faint edge. Copyright and page number are black Arial about 1.6%.

**Layout**

Two-column layout below a title row. The title sits top-left at about 4% from the left edge. The left column (about 0 to 45% width, 20 to 85% height) holds a light grey-blue panel with a 'Revenue Growth' heading and a bar chart; the right column holds a 'Growth Drivers' heading over four icon-and-label rows. A full-width navy band spans the bottom at 85.6 to 92.6% height, and a small footnote block sits bottom-left with copyright and page number bottom-right. A navigation graphic is top-right with a small caption beneath it.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled 'Revenue Growth', no axes or gridlines drawn. Two columns on a baseline: first bar light blue #59CBE8 labelled '3%' (bold) above it with category label '2019A - 2021A / CAGR'; second bar dark navy #002C5D, taller (about 2.0 times the first bar height), labelled 'MSD%' with superscript '*-a)' above it, category label 'Medium-term / Target'. A purple #4B089A arrow with a solid arrowhead runs diagonally from the top of the first bar up toward the top of the second bar, indicating growth. Baseline is a thin black horizontal line under both bars. No legend. Highlighted points: none beyond the arrow. Four icons in light purple #E3CCFF outlined circles with purple #640ACD line glyphs: (1) bar chart with rising arrow, (2) lightbulb with gear and sparkle rays, (3) two gears with an upward arrow and a checkmark gear, (4) magnifier with plus sign. Top-right navigation graphic: four circles in a rounded white pill, the first filled solid purple with concentric purple rings, the other three light grey-blue #B8C4D0 with faint rings; a purple vertical connector runs down from the first circle to a horizontal purple line with the caption beneath.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White #FFFFFF background. Title and headings in purple #640ACD; body and drivers text in near-black #0D0D0D; chart value labels black #000000; accent purple #4B089A for arrow and icons; navy #002D5D for the bottom band and second bar; light blue #59CBE8 for the first bar; grey-blue panel #DBE2E9 at 42% opacity. Typeface Arial regular (sans-serif); bold for '3%' and the band text. Title about 5.2% of slide height, section headings about 3.7%, driver text about 3.3%, chart labels about 2.2%, footnotes about 1.5%. Thin purple lines, no corner radii on bars, navigation pill is rounded with a soft shadow.

**Layout**

Title runs across the top left at about a 4% left margin, with a four-dot progress pill and its caption at the top right. The slide has two columns: a light grey left panel holding a stacked column chart with a column of organic growth labels, and a right column with a Market Position heading and four icon-and-label rows. A full-width navy band spans the lower part of the slide carrying the tagline, with a note at lower left, copyright centred-right and page number at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Stacked column chart, no chart title inside the chart; the heading Q3 YTD Organic Revenue Growth* of 6% sits above it and the sub-label Revenues by Segment sits above the columns. Two columns on a horizontal baseline at about 73.6% of slide height, spanning about 2.2% to 34.9% width. Column 2021 Q3 YTD total $13.0B: Imaging $7.0B (purple #640ACD, bottom), Ultrasound $2.3B (cyan #59CBE8), PCS $2.2B (blue #1D559B), PDx $1.5B (navy #002C5D, top). Column 2022 Q3 YTD total $13.4B: Imaging $7.3B, Ultrasound $2.5B, PCS $2.1B, PDx $1.5B. Segment values are printed inside each band in white. Organic Revenue Growth* column to the right, aligned to segments: 2% in italic navy #002C5D beside PDx, (0%) in italic blue #1D559B beside PCS, 6% in italic cyan #59CBE8 beside Ultrasound, 8% in italic purple #640ACD beside Imaging. Legend below the x-axis labels: purple square Imaging, cyan square Ultrasound, blue square PCS, navy square PDx; no axis numbers or gridlines. Right side: four circular icons with thin lilac outlines (#DCC8F5, about 0.2% stroke) each about 5.6% wide: first, a purple trophy star with the numeral 1 on a podium; second, a purple doctor with stethoscope; third, a purple globe showing the Americas; fourth, purple buildings with two curved arrows. Top-right pill badge: a white rounded pill with four circles, the first solid purple #640ACD with purple ring, the other three light grey #BCC6D2 with faint rings; a thin purple line underlines it with the caption below.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a light grey-blue panel #DBE2E9 at 42% opacity behind the left chart area. Title and headings in purple #640ACD; body labels near-black #0D0D0D; chart value labels white; tagline white on navy #002D5D; notes black #000000. Typeface Arial (ArialMT regular and Arial-BoldMT bold, Arial-ItalicMT for percentages), sans-serif. Title about 5.2% of slide height, section headings about 3.7%, body labels about 3.3%, chart labels about 2.6%, footnotes about 1.5%. Lines are thin dark grey #000000 baseline. Pill badge has a soft drop shadow and rounded ends; no gradients; no corner radii on bars.

**Layout**

Two-column body on a white 16:9 slide. The title sits top-left at about x 4.2%, y 6.8%, with a four-dot section tracker pill at top-right (x 80 to 100%, y 3 to 14%). The left column (x 0 to 45%, y 20.4 to 85.2%) is a light grey panel holding a donut chart with its heading centred above it; the right column (x 53 to 100%) holds the Key Drivers heading and four icon-and-label rows stacked vertically with even spacing. A full-width navy band (y 85.6 to 92.6%) carries a bold white takeaway sentence; the footer line sits below it with a left source note, a centred-right copyright line and the page number at the bottom right (x 94.8%).

**Visuals**

Donut chart titled Recurring Revenue (superscript -a)), with two segments split at the top (12 o'clock) and bottom (6 o'clock): left half navy #002D5D labelled Recurring, right half cyan #59CBE8 labelled Non-Recurring. Centre label reads ~50% in bold navy #0C2340. No axes or numeric values are printed other than ~50%; the split appears to be about 50/50. Legend beneath the donut: navy square then Recurring, cyan square then Non-Recurring. Four line icons in lilac-outlined circles, each in purple #833BD7 line art: (1) Lifecycle Services, three people figures arranged in a circular cycle with arrows; (2) Pharmaceutical Diagnostics, a syringe at a diagonal; (3) Digital Solutions and Software, a laptop with a cloud above and a phone-like device at right; (4) Consumables and Value-Added Offerings, a hand holding a small package with plus signs above. Top-right tracker: a white pill with four circles in grey-blue #BFC9D6 with thin concentric rings; the second circle is filled purple #C08FFA and is the active state, with a lilac connector line dropping to a caption.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white background with a light grey #DBE2E9 panel at 42% opacity behind the chart. Titles and section headings in violet #640ACD; body labels in near-black #0D0D0D; takeaway band text white on navy #002D5D; accents cyan #59CBE8, lilac #C08FFA and purple #833BD7. Typeface is Arial (ArialMT regular for headings and labels, Arial Bold for ~50% and the takeaway band), a neo-grotesque sans-serif. Title about 5.2% of slide height; body labels about 3.3%; takeaway about 3.3% bold; footers about 1.5%. Icon circles have thin lilac #E4C9FB outlines with no fill. The tracker pill has a soft drop shadow and rounded ends. No gradients.

**Layout**

Single 16:9 slide with a title at top left, a light grey left panel holding a two-bar chart, a right column of four icon-and-label rows, and a full-width navy takeaway bar above a footer; a small section navigator sits at top right. Title and column headings are left-aligned on a common top line; the chart heading is centred in the grey panel; footer note sits bottom left, copyright centre-right and page number at bottom right, roughly 5% margins.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled Adjusted EBIT Margin (asterisk for Non-GAAP), y-axis unit '% of revenue', no printed axis scale or gridlines. Medium-term Target is a solid navy #002C5D bar, unlabelled inside, with value text High-teens to 20% above it. A thick purple #4B089A arrow with arrowhead rises diagonally from the top of the historic bar toward the top of the target bar. No legend. Four circular icons in a column, each a lavender #E0C8F5 ring around a purple #7A1FD6 glyph: (1) a hexagonal network of nodes connected by lines; (2) an upward trending line with arrowhead above three ascending bars; (3) a lightbulb above two standing figures with bidirectional arrows between them; (4) a computer monitor showing a line-and-bar chart with a stand. Top-right section navigator: a rounded white pill with four grey-blue circular nodes, the third filled dark blue #1D559B, with a thin blue line and tick to the caption Optimizing Business Through Lean.

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a light grey #DBE2E9 panel (42% opacity) behind the left chart area. Accent colours: cyan #59CBE8 and #1EB0D8, navy #002C5D and #002D5D, purple #4B089A. Takeaway line is bold white Arial-style on navy. **Visuals**

Four line icons in navy #002D5D, one per row, left of each label. Row 1: a money bag marked with a dollar sign beside a bar chart with a rising arrow. Row 2: a briefcase with a gear in its centre. Row 3: a computer monitor showing a gauge with a water drop, and a gear at its lower right. Row 4: three boxes on a shelf above a worker figure with a cart and a box. Banner navy #002D5D with white Arial Bold text. Tracker caption in Arial regular blue #1D559B. Footer text in Arial regular black, small. Shapes are square-cornered with no visible shadows, except a soft shadow under the tracker pill.

### Slide 95

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: The margin bridge from 2022E to the medium-term target breaks the expansion into labelled drivers, showing the logic behind the number.
- Review: Slides carry one conclusion in a navy banner (13, 16, 28, 95), and the big-number layout on slide 13 and the waterfall on slide 95 read quickly.
- Suggested repair: Increase text size and thin out the dense pages on 22, 37 to 42 and 62 to 66, fix the cramped line spacing in the Driving Growth list on slide 11, and put values on the waterfall steps on slides 45, 67 and 95.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about 4% from the left edge and 7% from the top, in one line. A four-dot navigation pill is top-right, with its caption below it. The slide is split into two columns: a light grey chart panel on the left (about 0 to 45% width) and a list of four driver rows on the right under the heading 'Lean Margin Drivers'. A full-width navy banner runs across the lower slide, with footnotes bottom-left, the copyright line bottom-centre-right and the page number at bottom-right, about 5% from the right edge.

**Visuals**

Chart: waterfall bar chart titled 'Adj. EBIT Margin*' with no axes or gridlines, a single horizontal baseline. Four bars left to right: (1) light purple #C08FFA bar labelled '~15%' above it, top at about 39.5% of slide height, labelled '2022E Adj. EBIT Margin -a)*'; (2) light cyan #9EE0EF floating bar labelled 'Spin Dis-synergies', about 3% tall, sitting between about 39.5% and 42.7% of slide height, with no value printed; (3) dark slate #333F48 floating bar labelled 'Volume & Lean Optimization', spanning about 31.4% to 42.7% of slide height, with no value printed; (4) saturated violet #640ACD bar labelled 'High-teens to 20%' above it, top at about 31.4%, labelled 'Medium Term Target Adj. EBIT Margin*'. No legend. No highlighted points beyond the colour difference of bars 1 and 4. Icons: four pale lilac ring icons in a column at the right. (a) Purple rosette award ribbon icon labelled 'Commercial Excellence'. (b) Purple bar chart with rising arrow icon labelled 'Higher Margin Products from Innovation'. (c) Purple circular arrows connecting three nodes icon labelled 'Portfolio & Supply Chain Optimization'. (d) Purple money bag with wings icon labelled 'Cost and Expense Productivity'. Navigation graphic top-right: a white rounded pill containing four circles with thin grey concentric rings; the first, second and fourth are pale grey-blue #B9C6D6, the third is dark blue #1D559B and highlighted, with a thin blue vertical connector line from it down to the caption 'Optimizing Business Through Lean'.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Titles and section headings violet #640ACD. Body text near-black #0D0D0D. Bold labels black #000000. Banner text white #FFFFFF on navy #002D5D. Accent colours: light purple #C08FFA, violet #640ACD, cyan #9EE0EF, slate #333F48, blue #1D559B. Typefaces: Arial (ArialMT) regular for titles and body, Arial Bold for chart labels and banner, a Helvetica-like sans-serif. Title about 5.2% of slide height, regular. Section headings about 3.7%. Driver labels about 3.3%. Chart labels about 1.8%, bold. Footnotes about 1.5%. Lines and shapes: thin 1 px dark axis line; circle rings are thin lilac outlines; the grey chart panel has no border; nav pill has a soft grey drop shadow and rounded ends. No gradients. Icons have no corner radii.

Three line icons in light purple outline style above the column headings: left, a lightbulb containing a gear with a pencil-like cursor; centre, a puzzle piece pair with two pieces slightly separated; right, a handshake. A progress tracker at top right: a white rounded pill with soft shadow holding four circles, the first three pale grey-blue (#B8C4D4) with thin concentric rings, the fourth filled cyan #59CBE8 with rings, indicating the current section. ### Slide 108

**Text**

Non-GAAP Financial Measures
The non-GAAP financial measures disclosed in this presentation are supplemental measures of our performance and our liquidity that we believe help investors understand our financial condition, cash flows and operating results and assess our future prospects.
We believe that presenting these non-GAAP financial measures, in addition to the corresponding U.S. GAAP financial measures, are important supplemental measures that exclude non-cash or other items that may not be indicative of or are unrelated to our core
operating results and the overall health of our company. We believe that these non-GAAP financial measures provide investors greater transparency to the information used by management for its operational decision-making and allows investors to see our results
“through the eyes of management.” We further believe that providing this information assists our investors in understanding our operating performance and the methodology used by management to evaluate and measure such performance. When read in
conjunction with our U.S. GAAP results, these non-GAAP financial measures provide a baseline for analyzing trends in our underlying businesses and can be used by management as one basis for financial, operational, and planning decisions. Finally, these
measures are often used by analysts and other interested parties to evaluate companies in our industry.
Management recognizes that these non-GAAP financial measures have limitations, including that they may be calculated differently by other companies or may be used under different circumstances or for different purposes, thereby affecting their comparability
from company to company. In order to compensate for these and the other limitations, management does not consider these measures in isolation from or as alternatives to the comparable financial measures determined in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Readers
should review the reconciliations and should not rely on any single financial measure to evaluate our business.
We define these non-GAAP financial measures as:
Organic revenue: Total revenues excluding the effects of: (1) net sales from recent acquisitions and divestitures with less than a full year of comparable net sales; and (2) foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations in order to present revenue on a constant
currency basis.
Adjusted EBIT: Net income attributable to GE HealthCare excluding the effects of: (1) Interest and other financial charges - net; (2) Non-operating benefit costs; (3) Provision for income taxes; (4) Income (loss) from discontinued operations, net of taxes; (5) Net
income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests; (6) restructuring costs; (7) acquisition, disposition related charges; (8) Spin-Off and separation costs; (9) (gain)/loss of business dispositions/divestments; (10) amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets;
and (11) investment revaluation (gain)/loss. In addition, we may from time to time consider excluding other nonrecurring items to enhance comparability between periods.
Adjusted EBIT margin: Non-GAAP financial measure of Adjusted EBIT divided by the U.S. GAAP financial measure Total revenues for the same period.
We believe Adjusted EBIT and Adjusted EBIT margin provide management and investors with additional understanding of our business by highlighting the results from ongoing operations and the underlying profitability factors. These metrics exclude interest
expense, interest income, and tax expense, as well as unique and/or non-cash items, that can have a material impact on our results. We believe this provides additional insight into how our businesses are performing, on a normalized basis. However, Adjusted
EBIT and Adjusted EBIT margin should not be construed as inferring that our future results will be unaffected by the items for which the measure adjusts.
Adjusted Net Income: Net income attributable to GE HealthCare excluding (1) Non-operating benefit costs; (2) restructuring costs; (3) acquisition and disposition related charges (benefits); (4) Spin-Off and separation costs; (5) (gain)/loss of business
dispositions/divestments; (6) amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets; (7) investment revaluation (gain)/loss; (8) tax effect of reconciling items (items 1-7); (9) impact of tax law changes and (10) Income (loss) from discontinued operations, net of taxes.
In addition, we may from time to time consider excluding other nonrecurring items to enhance comparability between periods.
We believe Adjusted net income provides investors with improved comparability of underlying operating results and a further understanding and additional transparency regarding how we evaluate our business. Adjusted net income also provides management and
investors with additional perspective regarding the impact of certain significant items on our combined earnings. However, Adjusted net income should not be construed as inferring that our future results will be unaffected by the items for which the measure
adjusts.
Free cash flow: Cash from (used for) operating activities - continuing operations adjusting for the effects of (1) additions to PP&E and internal-use software; (2) dispositions of PP&E; and (3) impact of factoring programs.
We believe that Free cash flow provides management and investors with an important measure of our ability to generate cash on a normalized basis. Free cash flow also provides insight into our flexibility to allocate capital, including reinvesting in the company for
future growth, paying down debt, paying dividends, and pursuing other opportunities that may enhance stockholder value. We believe investors may find it useful to compare Free cash flow performance without the effects of the factoring program discontinuation.
The cash flow from operating activity (“CFOA”) impact from factoring programs discontinued in 2021 represents the cash that we would have otherwise collected in the period had customer receivables not been previously sold to GE in those discontinued
programs.
We typically invest in PP&E over multiple periods to support new product introductions and increases in manufacturing capacity and to perform ongoing maintenance of our manufacturing and distribution operations. We believe that while PP&E expenditures and
dispositions will fluctuate period to period, we will need to maintain a material level of net PP&E spend to maintain ongoing operations and growth of the business.
Our historical Free cash flow includes interest expense associated with the internal and external factoring of current receivables and other financial charges. Interest expense associated with external debt that is currently held by GE is not currently included in the
combined financial statements and related notes. Additionally, Free cash flow does not represent residual cash flows available for discretionary expenditures, due to the fact the measures do not deduct the payments required for debt repayments.
